de yang rang rang gi lam chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ de dag gi mtshan nyid du ma shes pa la 'jug pa'i phyir/ pha rol du phyin pa dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pas bsdus pa yin no/ /de ltar rang sangs rgyas ni nyan thos dang grub pa'i mtha' gcig pas de'i khongs su bsdus la/ nyan thos ni phyis theg pa chen por 'jug pas/ rgyu'am/ rkang stegs sam/ ngal gso'i theg pa ste pha rol du phyin pa'i phyogs tsam du mthun par bsdus pa yin no/ /don gnyis pa 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa la gnyis te/ phyi thub pa rgyud kyi theg pa dang*/ nang gsang sngags kyi theg pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ bya ba'i rgyud kyis ni rang nyid bran dang*/ lha rje yi tshul las dngos grub 'dod cing*/ khrus dang gtsang sbra gtsor byed pas bsgrubs la/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyis ni rang dam tshig sems dpa' dang*/ lha ye shes sems dpa' gnyis spun nam grogs po'i tshul las dngos grub 'dod cing*/ lta sgom yo ga dang 'dra la/ spyod pa kri ya ltar byed pas gnyis bcas kyi theg pa zhes bya'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni sems kyi sgom pa gtso ste/ spyod pa grogs tsam tshol bas rang dam tshig par bskyed la/ lha ye shes pa gzhan nas bsgrub cing dngos grub len par 'dod do/ /gnyis pa nang pa gsang sngags pa ni/ rnal 'byor chen po ste/ gang la'ang thabs kyis zin pa'i sgo nas spang blang dang bya btsal med par spyod cing*/ chos thams cad ye nas lha'i dkyil 'khor du sangs rgyas par 'dod pas/ yin pa la gsal 'debs pa tsam las ma yin pa zhig gdod sgrub par mi 'dod cing*/ lha bskyed de ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa yang phyogs gzhan nas 'ong bar mi 'dod de/ rang gi sems kyi rang bzhin goms shing brtan par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye na thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa gtso bor bstan pa pha'i rgyud dang*/ shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa gtso bor bstan pa ma'i rgyud dang*/

bskyed rdzogs gnyis su med pa zung du 'jug pa gnyis su med pa'i rgyud de gsum du gnas so/ /'di dag ni gzhi ye nas dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du ting nge 'dzin zab mos gsal btab ste/ dbang bskur zhing bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pas/ 'bras bu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur te/ 'og min du zhi ba dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor mngon du mdzad nas sprul pa'i sku gang la gang 'dul du lhun gyis grub par 'byung bar 'dod do/ /de'ang rgyud sde bzhi po de dag kyang*/ dus dang*/ mi rigs dang*/ dbang po'i rim pas snang ste/ gtsang sbra can bram ze la bya ba'i rgyud/ rje rigs gnyis bcas 'dzin pa rnams la spyod pa'i rgyud/ rgyal rigs la rnal 'byor rgyud/ gdol pa'am dmangs la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud 'byung ba'o/ / de dag spyod pa'i dus kyang rdzogs ldan/ gsum ldan/ gnyis ldan/ rtsod ldan dang*/ dbang po'ang*/ rtul bo/ 'bring*/ rnon po/ shin tu rnon po rnams la gsungs so/ /gsang ba rdzogs pa chen po ni/ chos thams cad gzhi nas lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas te bden pa dbyer med pa ni/ 'di nyid las/ don dam kun rdzob dbyer med pa'i/ /mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ zhes pa la sogs pas/ ye nas mnyam rdzogs chen po gcig tu sangs rgyas par bstan te/ lam bsgrub pa'ang de nyid gsal bar byed pa tsam las gzhan pa mi 'dod cing*/ sems can gyi dus na sems dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi dus na ye shes rang snang ba de yang*/ yod med la sogs pa gang du'ang ma grub pa'i tshul gyis gnas par 'dod la/ khyad par du 'khrul snang gzhi med pa rmi lam ltar gdod ma dang tha ma na med la/ glo bur du da ltar rang snang bas gnad zab mos dag par sla zhing*/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin nyin snang gi sems ltar ma 'khrul par ye nas de ltar gnas pas/ tshe 'dir 'bad na 'grub pa'i gnad kyang de ltar 'dod do/

de'ang tha snyad du 'khrul ba rtsa ba med la rten dang bral ba smig sgyu'i chu dang dri za'i grong khyer dang 'dra la/ ye shes ni dngos snang don byed nus pa'i rnam pa dang 'dra zhing*/ don dam par de gnyis ka'ang rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las gzhan du grub pa med par 'dod do/ /gsang sngags kyi phyogs phyi nang gnyis la brten pa 'di dag gi don rgyas par ni gzhung nyid 'chad pa'i skabs su rgya cher ston pas skabs 'dir ma bstan cing spros pas chog go /spyi don gsum pa rgyud don dngos dang 'brel ba don gyi rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ spyi'i 'brel ba sgrub pa/ dgos 'brel gtan la dbab pa/ rgyud don ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la lnga las/ spyir grub mtha' tsam la log par rtog pa dgag pa ni/ so so'i skye bo 'ga' zhig na re/ phyi dang nang gi grub pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba/ dge sbyong dang bram ze g.yo can dag gis 'tsho ba bsgrub pa'i ched du byas pa las/ yang dag pa'i don yod par ma mthong ste/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni gzhan dang mthun par myong la/ 'chi ba dang rgud pa la sogs pa ni mi khegs/ thar pa'i lam ni 'di'o zhes brjod kyang bstan du med pa dang*/ tshe snga phyi dang las rgyu 'bras kyang mig gis blta ba'i yul du ma gyur pa la sogs pa rgyu mtshan du ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ de dag ston pa'i grub pa'i mthas ci bya zhe na/ de ltar mi lta ste/ grub pa'i mtha' ni khyed so so'i skye bo rnams la'ang bden par gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar las rgyu 'bras 'dod pa'ang*/ 'jig rten na pha ma la sogs pa'i drin can la phan gnod byas pa'i 'bras bu tshe 'di nyid la 'byung bar 'dod pa dang mtshungs so/ /lung tshad mar 'dod pa ltar/ khyed cag pha mes rgan rabs kyi gtam la tshad mar 'dzin pa gnyis mtshungs pa dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la brten nas lam bsgrub pa bzhin/ khyed kyang mna' dang chad gtso bo'i sgo nas ya rabs kyi dam pa bsgrub pa gnyis mtshungs pa dang*/

byis pa la sogs pa 'gas tshe snga ma dran pa bzhin du phyi ma'ang yod par mtshungs pa dang*/ gang zhig shi nas sman dang btsan la sogs pa'i yul du skyes nas lung ston pa bzhin du/ thar ba'i yul yod par mtshungs pa dang*/ rang gis ma rtogs pa'i don gtsug lag mkhan gyi lung la ltos pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi lugs kyang*/ grub pa'i mtha' dang tshul mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan du ma yod pa'i phyir/ thar pa dang legs pa bsgrubs pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i gzhung la smad par mi bya ba kho na'o/ /'jig rten gyi chos lugs las ji skad 'byung ba'i don legs pa dang chos la sogs pa'i grub pa rnams thar pa bsgrub par don mtshungs te/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis dbu ma las/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*/ / lha yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /rim gyis thar pa 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu sangs rgyas pa'i grub pa'i mtha' la log par rtog pa dgag pa ni/ phyi rol ba dag na re/ nged kyi rig byed bzhi po ma byas par rang byung ba/ bdag gi de kho na nyid ston pa la skur pa 'debs shing*/ dus phyis glo bur du byung ba'i phyir/ nged kyi grub pa'i mtha' dang mi mthun pas/ khyed kyi ston pa thams cad mkhyen par tshad mas ma grub pa dang*/ des bstan pa'i chos kyang yid brtan du rung ba ma yin no/ /zhes mthun snang du ma grub pa'i log par rtog pa la/ dbang po rnam pa gsum gyis mthun snang du yang dag par bstan par bsgrub ste/ dang po lung bstan pa'i dpang po ni/ khyed rang gi gzhung phyi mo las/ u dum wa ra'i me tog dang 'dra bar rgyal ba rgya lam na lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa bram ze'am rgyal rigs las 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur te/ lhums su zhugs pa na/ glang po che thal dkar mche ba drug pa/ gdong gseragyi drwa bas g.yogs pa/

srog chags lham bu chu shel ltar mgo dmar la 'dril ba zhig yum gyi glo g.yas nas 'jug pa'i mtshan ma yum gyi rmi lam du 'byung la/ de bltams pa na yang mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan par 'gyur zhing*/ de rab tu ma byung na ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur la/ gal te rab tu byung na ni lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa bzhin du nged kyi ston pa byung ba'i phyir dang*/ gang zag gi dbang po ni/ shākya thub pa bltams pa de'i tshe ri bo gangs can nas drang srong mdog nag gis tsha bo mes sbyin dang lhan cig 'ong ste mtshan bltas nas 'di skad du/ rtog ge ba rnams thams cad blo 'khrul te/ /rtsod pa'i dus na 'khor los sgyur mi 'byung*/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin nges/ /zhes smas pa dang*/ dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa'i gnas skabs na yang*/ bram ze dang*/ drang srong dang*/ rgyal po la sogs rigs pa dang*/ yon tan dang*/ mthu dang*/ phyogs dang*/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba rnams kyis 'dud cing bsti stangs du byas pa dang*/ sa'i lha mos dpang po byas te/ bdud la sogs pa'i mthu dang gzi brjid che ba'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za tshe bskal par thub pa dag gis mchod cing thams cad mkhyen par dbang bskur ba yin no/ /lung dang 'brel ba'i dpang po yang yod de/ khyod kyi rig byed las/ gang zag gi bdag brdzus te skyes pa'i sems can gang yin pa de yang yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ blo gros dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ lus kyi tshangs par spyod pa'i sgo nas gang zag yongs su dag par byas te rnam par grol zhes 'dod do/ /kho bo cag bye brag tu smra ba dang po'i lta ba yang gang zag yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir/ shes rab dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/

de'i grogs tshul khrims kyis thar pa sgrub par 'dod pa'i lung gi don yang 'brel pa 'grub cing mtshungs pas yid brtan du rung ba nyid do/ /khyed kyi gzhung las gang zag rtag par 'dod pa dang*/ kho bo cag mi rtag par 'dod pa la sogs pa cung zad mi 'dra ba yod kyang*/ skyon med de/ khyed rang gi lta ba'i bye brag rnams kyang rtag chad la sogs phan tshun nang mi mthun pa bzhin no/ /dper na tsandan dang*/ a mra la sogs pa cung zad mi 'dra yang shing du gcig pa nyid dang*/ yang khyab 'jug gi gzhung las/ ming tsam las ni rab 'das shing*/ /yod dang med pa rnam par spang*/ /skye dang 'jig las nges grol ba/ /de ni nor lha'i bu zhes bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ nged kyi yongs su rdzogs pa dbu ma'i lta ba las/ chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /'gags pa med pa skye med pa/ /tha dad don min don gcig min/ zhes pas/ nang don mthun pas na/ sangs rgyas ni thams cad mkhyen pa yin cing*/ des bstan pa'i chos kyang phun sum tshogs pa yin par khyed dang mthun pa nyid yin pas/ smad par mi bya ba kho na'o/ /gsum pa khyad par du theg pa chen po la log par rtog pa dgag pa ni/ nyan thos sde pa kha cig na re/ theg pa chen po zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa med de/ yod na nged kyi ston pa gnas brtan 'od srung chen po sogs ston pa dang 'bral med du gnas pa rnams kyis thos dgos pa la ma thos pa'i phyir dang*/ nged kyi grub ba'i mtha' dang mi mthun pa'i phyir dang*/ klu sgrub snying po la sogs pa'i rtog ge ba rnams kyis byas pa'i phyir zhes rgol ba ni/ bye brag tu bshad pa'i mdzod chen mo las/ bde gshegs chos kyi 'khor lo yang*/ /bden gnyis las gzhan ma gsungs par/ /'od srung chen pos mkhyen te phyis/ /gzhan gyis kun tu brtags phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /'di la'ang gsum las/ dang po lung bstan pa'i dpang po ni/ khyed rang gi 'dul ba lung rnam par 'byed pa las/

byang chub sems dpa' rnams bskal ba grangs med pa gsum du dka' ba sna tshogs pa spyod cing*/ sems stobs chen pos sems can gyi don nyams su len pa dang*/ shes rab chen pos slob dpon gyi rgyud du nges par byung ste/ mthar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes theg pa chen po lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa lung bstan pa dang*/ gang zag gi dpang po'ang*/ gnas brtan chen po shā ri'i bu dang*/ mo'u gal gyi bu dang rab 'byor la sogs pa yod cing*/ lung dang 'brel pa'i dbang po yang*/ khyed kyi gzhung las bden pa bzhi'i chos mi rtag la sogs bcu drug tsam du rtogs shing tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin gyi thar pa sgrub pa la/ nged kyi'ang rgyud bla mar/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la/ /bde gnas thob phyir sman ni bsten par bya ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam/ /shes bya spang bya rig par bya zhing brten par bya/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshul mtshungs la/ lta ba dang ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la sogs pa'i nang tshan cung zad mi 'dra yang skyon med de/ khyed rang gi sde pa bco brgyad po'ang so so'i nang tshan mi 'dra ba bzhin no/ /gzhan yang gnas brtan 'od srung gis ma thos kyang*/ shā ri'i bu la sogs pas thos pas/ 'khor du gnas pa'i dus mi 'gal ba yin te/ sangs rgyas la gsung chos kyi dung mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ de skad du'ang 'dul ba lung rnam 'byed du/ chu klung nai rañdza na'i 'grum du ston pas bslab pa'i gzhi/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba rnams bcas shing bden pa bzhi'i chos bstan pa de'i tshe/ kun tu rgyu rnams kyis cung zad kyang ma thos la/ nye ba'i lnga sde rnams kyis thos pa bzhin no/ / de bas na theg pa chen po yang dag pa nyid du khas blang zhing gzung bar 'os so/ /bzhi pa gsang sngags la log par rtog pa dgag pa ni/ rgyu'i theg pa 'dzin pa kha cig na re/

gsang sngags ni chos ma yin te/ gzhi 'khor 'das gnyis su med par ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i phyir dang*/ lam nyon mongs dug lnga mi spong bar spyod pa'i phyir dang*/ 'bras bu tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i phyir zhes rgol na/ 'di la'ang*/ lung du bstan pa'i dpang po ni/ khyed rang gi mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa'i rgyal po las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs ngos kyi/ /mi las skal ldan rig pa 'dzin/ /rgyal po dzaḥzhes bya ba la/ /thugs rje mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis// lag na rdo rjes snang bar byed/ /ces dang*/ mya ngan 'das pa'i mdo las kyang*/ bstan bcos gsang sngags ci yang gsungs te/ de thams cad ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin par shes par gyis zhes so/ /gang zag gi dpang po ni/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyi bzhin du 'brang zhing gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa ste/ zhes pa dang*/ lho phyogs gyad kyi yul du lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas dbang bskur bar thun mong du grags pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes gsang sngags bsdus nas skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lung 'brel ba'i dpang po yang yod de/ gsang sngags las gzhi dkyil 'khor du sangs rgyas pa ltar/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig bdag dang sangs rgyas rnams/ /rang bzhin mnyam par rab gnas shing*/ /mi gnas len pa med pa ste/ /de dag bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang*/ /rnam par shes dang sems pa dag /grangs med de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ de dag thub pa chen por 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ lam nyon mongs pa mi spong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang rang bzhin du bstan pa nyid/

dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo las/ nyon mongs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung ngo*/ /zhes pa dang*/ de dag rang gar lam du spyod pa ma yin te/ dug sngags kyis zin pa'i dug la spyod pa ltar/ thabs kyis zin nas spyod la/ de nyid ni rang gi gzhung nas kyang bshad de/ theg bsdus las/ thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la/ /nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur/ / zhes pa dang*/ 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ rang gi lus bud med kyi gzugs su mngon par sprul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdun na rtag tu gnas so/ /zhes so/ /'bras bu yang skye ba gcig dang*/ bdun dang*/ bcu drug tshun chad kyis thob pa nyid/ brtson pa dang thabs kyi mchog gis phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin tshe 'dir bsgrub te/ rten des myur du thob par 'dod pa bzhin du/ yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' chen po gang*/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba rnams yongs su dag la/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa chen pos sems can dpag tu med/ grangs med/ gzhal du med pa/ yongs su smin par bya ba zhig yin na ni/ de 'dod na zhag bdun gyis kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya zhing*/ 'dod na bskal pa grangs med par tshul khrims chen po la gnas par byed do/ /zhes pa dang tshul mtshungs pa zhig go /'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma sbyangs/ sems can smin par ma byas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du ma bsags par sangs rgyas pa ni mi rigs la/ gal te sangs rgyas na'ang nyan rang gi dgra bcom bzhin du 'gyur ro zhe na/ lan du gnyis las/ tshul mtshungs pa ni/ khyed kyang grangs med gsum na sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas de nyan rang dgra bcom ltar 'gyur te/ dmigs bsal gsum po de rdzogs par ma byas pa'i phyir ro/ /ma grub na/ byams pa la sogs pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la dge ba rgyu med par thal te/

thub pas byas zin pa'i phyir ro/ /kho na re/ rang nyid kyi smon lam dang*/ mthun pa'i rdzogs smin la sogs gsum po de byas pa yin pas skyon med do zhe na/ 'dir yang mtshungs pa ste/ rang nyid kyi skal pa dang mthun pa'i gdul bya thar pa'i lam la bkod pa dang*/ snang srid thams cad dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rang bzhin du zhing khams sbyangs pa dang*/ bskyed pa dang*/ rdzogs pa/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byas pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lan dngos ni/ tshe gcig la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur yang nyan rang dang mi mtshungs te/ thabs snying rje chen pos zin pas theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang ldan cing*/ shes rab chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i tshul la mkhas pas lam sbyangs te sangs rgyas pa na/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i don 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ dus bskal pa grangs med pa gsum kho na'i nges bzung yang*/ zhag dang tshes kyis bgrangs pa'i grangs med pa ma yin gyi/ sgo gsum gyi dag pa skyong ba la de skad du grags te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ grangs med pa ni rnam pa gsum/ /lus ngag yid kyi rang bzhin te/ /khams rnams dang ni rlung rnams dang*/ /ye shes grangs med rdzogs pa yis/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ khyed rang gi mdo sde thar pa chen po las kyang*/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi gnas ngan len rnams yongs su sbyong ba'i phyir/ 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams kyi dbye bas bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du mngon par brtson te/ zhes sgo gsum dang khams gsum gyi dri ma spong ba la de skad du btags par mngon te/ phyi'i dus na ji lta ba bzhin du grangs su gsog mi dgos so/ /de'ang ded dpon thabs la mkhas pas mi nag mdung thung can bsad pas skad cig la tshogs bskal pa bzhi khri 'dum pa la sogs pa du ma yod pa'i phyir/

dpes kyang shes par bya ste/ nyi ma dang*/ nor bu las skad cig gi rtsol ba yun thung bar skyes pa'i me de nyid me mtshan nyid pa ma yin par thal te/ bud shing la sogs pa rgyun ring po nyid nas rtsol bas ma sbyangs pa'i phyir ro/ /de las byung ba'am me yin te/ btso bsreg gi bya ba byed pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ bskal par ma bsgrub kyang sangs rgyas yin te/ don gnyis mthar thug lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa gsang sngags snga 'gyur la log par rtog pa dgag pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa 'god pa ni/ kha cig na re/ khyed kyi rgyud 'di dag ha cang go sla zhing*/ tshig mi mdzes pa ci rigs pa snang bas/ sdeb sbyor gyi tshul la sogs pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyir dang*/ theg pa gong 'og cha shas dang*/ nang tshan mi 'dra ba rgyud gcig na'ang bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ bldab pa dang*/ zlos par yang 'ga' zhig gnas pa'i phyir/ gang zag gis sbyar ba'o zhes 'dzer to/ /de'i lan bshad pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje mnga' bas ni sems can gyi go sla zhing rtogs par bya ba'i phyir bstan pa yin gyi/ mi go bar bya ba'i phyir rig byed so so'i mchod sbyin lta bu ma yin cing*/ tshig kyang sngon gyi dus kyi skad rnying la brten pa ci rigs su snang ba ni/ de dus de bas lhag pa'i skad gcig la brten du med pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam pa gcig tu na go sla ba'i phyir lo paṇa thugs rje can gyis bsgyur te/ 'jig rten pa'i gtsug lag ngan pa de dag gis ma bslad pas nor ba'i gzhi med par byas pa yin no/ /gal te tshig legs pa 'ba' zhig legs pa yin na snyan ngag mkhan pos rang bzo byas pa'ang de ltar 'gyur ba dang*/ rnam pa gcig tu bod kyi chos ji snyed pa'ang yang dag par mi rung ste saṃ skṛ ta'i tshig dang sdeb sbyor lta bu'i brgya stong gi cha yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /ltos sa la ltos nas 'jog go zhe na mtshungs te/

'dir yang de bas dman pa la ltos nas mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /nang tshan gyi cha shas mi 'dra bas chos yang dag par mi 'gyur na/ kye rdo rje bla med kyi rgyud du nyan thos sde pa bzhi dang*/ bden pa bzhi'i rnam bzhag byung bas yang dag pa ma yin par 'gyur ba dang*/ sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las rgyud kyi 'khor du gnas brtan kun dga' bo la sogs pa nyan thos byung bas gdul bya dang 'dul byed theg pa dang bsam pa 'gal ba dang*/ nges brjod bla ma'i rgyud du 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes byung bas na rgyud ma yin par thal ba dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lor gzugs med kyi lha la gnas nges pa can bshad pas chos mngon pa dang mi mthun pa dang*/ 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od las/ byang chub sems dpa' lung bstan 'byung gi rnal 'byor pa lung bstan mi 'byung ngo*/ /zhes bshad pas/ mtshan nyid las sngags dman par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i nang tshan cung zad 'gal bar snang bas de dag yang dag pa ma yin nam zhes mtshungs so/ /bldab bu dang zlos bur bstan pas the tshom gyi gzh-ir ga la rung ste/ dri ma med pa che chung gi mdo dang*/ ting 'dzin rgyal po/ ting 'dzin mchog dam pa'i mdo/ mya ngan las 'das pa che chung gi mdo la sogs pa la'ang*/ bldab pa dang zlos par snang ba dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i byang chub sems kyi le'u dang*/ rigs kyi yum dang*/ khro bo bcu'i sngags dang*/ las dang drag po'i brtul zhugs/ phur bu byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga lta bu dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi pa che chung dang*/ kri rna ya ma ri che chung*/ de la sogs pa'i rgyud 'di dag la'ang*/ nang tshan dang che chung la sogs pa'i ci rigs su zlos bur bldab na yang dag pa ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'di dag yang dag pa ma yin pa'i tshad ma ci zhig yod/ don ji lta ba bzhin mtshungs te/ smin byed dbang dang*/ grol byed bskyed rdzogs dang*/ thabs lam dang grol lam la sogs pa mthun la/

nang tshan cung zad mi 'dra bas de ltar 'gyur na ni/ khyed rang gi brtag gnyis dang*/ gdan bzhi dang*/ dus 'khor la sogs pa rnams su/ thabs dang lha'i bskyed rdzogs mi 'dra ba du mar snang bas/ skyon de nyid zhugs par 'gyur/ gal te gang zag gis bsdebs pa zhig na yang skur pa gdab par mi rung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin rlabs gdul bya'i rgyud la zhugs pas phan pa dang bde bar dgongs pa yin srid pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni thar pa dang zhi ba sgrub pa yin la/ de yang de dang tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir na ston pas gsungs bzhin gus par bya dgos te/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo las/ kun dga' bo nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas rnam par grol ba dang*/ ye shes mthong ba'i chos su gyur pa gang byung ba de dag kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi gsungs par rigs par bya ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can rnams la phan pa dang bde ba don du gnyer ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis byin brlabs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las kyang*/ thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang*/ /zhes so/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs 'byung ba yang sems can gyi rnam par rtog pa dang 'dres nas 'byung ba'i phyir te/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdor/ bdud sdig to can gyis chos kyi rnam grangs bshad pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyis legs so gnang ba dang*/ sngon bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa na byung ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs la'ang*/ 'khor rnams gcig la gcig bgro ba mang gi/de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi zhal nas de tsam mang ba ma yin pa dang*/ lha'i bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig rgyal ba rnam 'dren gyis/ /'gro ba yongs su skyobs pa na/ /chos kyi phung po tshad med de/ /dus gsum dus ni rnam kun du/ /don dang mthun pa'i rang bzhin ni/

/mya ngan 'das pa zhir 'gro ba'i/ / bdud rtsi bsil ba rab 'byung ba/ /padma dang ni dpag bsam shing*/ /rnga bo che las byung ba yang*/ /sangs rgyas chos su shes par gyis/ /de bzhin lha dang mi rnams dang*/ /drang srong dag gi rang byung du/ /dam pa'i chos kyi tshogs bstan pa/ /de yang 'dren pas byin brlabs te/ /'gro ba yongs su skyob pa'i phyir/ /thabs kyi mchog ni bstan pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de bas na lung 'brel ba'i dpang po yod cing*/ nyams su blangs pa las ji skad smos pa'i yon tan 'byung na gang gi lugs kyang yang dag pa nyid de/ skur pa gdab par mi bya'o/ /de'ang dge ba dang zhi ba 'phel zhing thar par 'gro ba ni chos yin la/ de las bzlog na chos ma yin pas/ nges pa nyid du gzung ngo*/ /rnam pa gcig tu na/ sangs rgyas la brten kyang 'ga' zhig gis mtshams med pa gsog cing*/ nor ba med pa'i chos las kyang dam tshig nyams pa'i slob dpon gyi bar du chod pas dngos grub mi 'byung ba la sogs pa mthong ba'i phyir na/ skyon smra ba po khyed cag gi gzhung la'ang*/ yang dag pa dang*/ yang dag pa ma yin pa ci rigs su mthong zhing*/ dngos grub 'byung bar ma mthong ba'i phyir yid brtan du rung ba ci zhig yod/ yang dag pa'i chos dang gang zag la skur pa 'debs pa ni chos kyis phongs pa'i las kyis dmyal ba chen po rnams su brgyud pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa shin tu chen po la reg pas nam du yang bsam par bya ba ma yin no/ /de dag gis bstan pa spyi'i dgos 'brel bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa dgos 'brel gtan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ spyir ngag tsam la yod pa'i dgos 'brel/ rgyud don lus la yod pa'i dgos 'brel/ dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos 'brel yan lag bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ rtog ldan gyi ngag des bstan par bya ba'i don ni de'i brjod bya/ ngag de las rtogs par bya ba ni dgos pa/ rtogs pa las 'bras bu grub pa ni nying dgos/

dgos pa ngag las byung ba ni 'brel pa'o/ /dper na bum pa ni brjod bya/ bum pa 'on cig gi sgra las de thos pa ni dgos pa/ de las chu blangs te bya ba byed pa ni nying dgos/ de dag gcig la gcig brten pa ni 'brel pa ste/ med na mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje las/ brjod 'brel dgos dang yang dgos pa'i/ /rgyud kyi yan lag bzhi ru 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la gsum ste/ ngos bzung*/

gcig tha dad brtags/ grangs nges pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud 'di'i gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ni brjod bya/ de'i mtshon pa ming tshig yi ger snang ba'i gzhung le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni rjod byed/ rjod byed tshig rgyud la brten nas brjod bya don gyi rgyud rtogs pa ni dgos pa/ rtogs pa bzhin nyams su blangs pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don grub pa ni nying dgos/ 'bras bu 'grub pa de nyid rgyud don rtogs pa la ltos shing*/ rtogs pa'ang rjod byed dang brjod bya la brten pa'am ltos pa ni 'brel pa'o/ /tshul 'di nyid man ngag lta phreng du gsungs te/ gzhi rang bzhin gyi rgyud brjod bya/ rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid dgos pa/ rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid 'brel pa/ de gnyis kyis mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dbye na gsum las/ gzhi dkyil 'khor gsum du ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don brjod bya/ de ston pa'i tshig gleng gzhi dang gleng bslang pa lta bu ni rjod byed/ de nyid ston pas gsungs pa bzhin 'khor gyis rtogs pa dgos pa/ de nyid gdul bya 'dul byed gzhan la brten nas don grub pa nying dgos/ de dag gcig la gcig brten pa ni 'brel pa'o/ /lam dbang mnos te bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel ni brjod bya/ de ston pa'i tshig yi ge sprin gyi tshogs sgrub pa la sogs pa rgyud don dngos rnams rjod byed/ de la brten nas rnal 'byor pas chos thams cad thabs shes zung 'jug tu rtogs pa ni dgos pa/ rtogs bzhin nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu grub pa ni nying dgos/ de dag gcig la gcig brten cing*/ khyad par du/ dkyil 'khor gzungs ma dang 'brel/ gzungs ma dbang dang 'brel/ dbang sgrub pa dang 'brel/ sgrub pa 'bras bu dang 'brel ba'o/ / 'bras bu dkyil 'khor gsum du sangs rgyas nas sku dang ye shes su lhun gyis grub pa ni brjod bya/

de ston pa'i tshig gleng gzhi gleng bslang ba lta bu ni rjod byed/ sems can gyi don du sprul pa 'phro ba ni dgos pa/ de las 'gro ba'i don gnyis grub pa ni nying dgos/ de dag gcig la gcig brten du byung ba ni thugs rje ye shes kyi 'brel ba grub pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyud 'di'i tshig don rtogs pa'i dgos 'brel gcig gam tha dad snyam na/ snang ba'i brjod bya don spyi dngos med yin la/ dgos pa 'brel pa nying dgos gsum ngo bo gcig pa bkag tsam gyis tha dad do/ / brjod bya ni nying dgos 'ga' zhig dang rdzas gcig la/ 'ga' zhig gi rgyu yin no/ /dgos pa dang nying dgos ni rdzas tha dad/ 'brel ba ni 'brel sa so so la gcig tu yod/ gsum pa ni dgos pa la ltos pa'i grangs nges pa yin te/ rgyud 'di la dgos pa can gyi brjod bya med dam/ nying dgos dang ldan pa'i dgos pa med dam/ don du gnyer bya'i nying dgos med dam/ thabs dang thabs can ma 'brel lam snyam pa ste/ rtogs ldan rgyud don la mi 'jug pa'i gegs bzhi sel ba la/ dgos pa can gyi brjod bya dang*/ nying dgos dang ldan pa'i dgos pa dang*/ don du blang bya'i nying dgos dang*/ thabs dang thabs byung gi 'brel pa rnams bstan to/ /gsum pa dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos 'brel yan lag bzhi las/ brjod bya ni rgyud kyi dgos 'brel bzhi'o/ /dgos pa ni rgyud kyi dgos 'brel khyad par can rtogs pa'o/ /nying dgos ni dgos sogs khyad par can rtogs nas rtogs ldan rgyud la 'jug pa'o/ /de'ang lugs gnyis te/ dbang po rtul po dad pa'i rjes 'brang nges pa skyes nas 'jug pa dang*/ rnon po chos kyi rjes 'brang shas cher 'dzin pa'i the tshom skyes nas 'jug pa ste/ gnyis ka'ang dgos 'brel gyi ngag las dgos sogs rtogs par mnyam zhing*/ rtogs nas rgyud la 'jug par mtshungs so/ /rtogs nas 'jug pa rtogs pa las 'byung*/

rtogs pa dgos 'brel bkod pa'i ngag las byung ba 'brel pa'o/ /de dag gis ni rgyud 'di'i dgos 'brel legs par bstan zin pa'o/ /gsum pa rgyud don ngos bzung ba ni/ 'phags pa rtogs pa'i rgyal po rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las gsang ba'i snying po de kho nyid nges pa'i le'u zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di la gsungs pa po'i che ba/ des gsungs pa rgyud kyi che ba/ che ba de dang ldan pa'i rgyud nyid bstan cing bshad pa'i tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ thun mong du grags pa'i ston pa ltar/ gang zag gcig gis sems bskyed nas/ lam bsgrubs te/ zhing khams 'di zhes phyogs su chad pa'i gnas gcig na gnas pa'i ston pa ma yin gyi/ thog ma med pa'i dus su gzhi thog nas mngon par byang chub cing*/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi spyi dpal gdod ma'i mgon po/ yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i 'byor pa chen pos chos kyi sku'i zhing na/ dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs pas rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa ni mnga' dbang rdzogs pa'i ston pa kun tu bzang po ste/ rgya mtsho las/ gdod nas mngon par byang chub pa/ mnga' dbang rdzogs pa'i ston pa ni/ /kun las khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir/ rtag tu chos sku'i zhing na bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du rang snang lhun stug po bkod pa'i zhing na/ rgyal tshab kyi ston pa rigs lnga gangs can mtsho so so'i dkyil 'khor/ ye shes rin po che'i ngo bo las grub pa/ rtse mo phyogs kun tu 'khyil zhing*/ rgya phyogs bcur ma chad pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa thams cad du khyab pa ni longs sku rang gi ngo bo'i snang tshul te/ le'u dang por/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas longs spyod chen po/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa thams cad dang*/

so so ma yin tha mi dad pa'i rang bzhin/ 'og min gyi gnas mtha' dang dbus med pa na/ gzhi tshad med pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsal ba la/ ye shes rin po che 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ dgu pa las/ zhing khams bsam yas rnam dag dang*/ /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ /'khor lo'i rgyan dang rol mo'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas ma lus kun/ /mthong nas nye bar mnyes pa dang*/ /rgya chen gsung las don 'byung ba'ang*/ /mthun pa'i ye shes rang snang ba'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ kun gsal las/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzug sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ / thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin las/ gdul bya'i gnas rigs gsum du rig pa khyad par can gyi ston pa rigs gsum mgon po rang byon pa ni thugs rje lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin te/ ye shes gsang ba las/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dag las/ /thog ma mtha' ma dbus med pa'i/ /sems dpa' gzugs mdzes padma dang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ye shes che/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dag las 'dir thugs kyi sems dpa' gsang ba'i bdag po ste/ mnyam sbyor las/ sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /zhes pa dang*/ ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje'i sku ste sku che ba/ /phyag na rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje rgyal po dga' chen po/ /zhes pa la sogs gsungs te/ kun tu bzang po de nyid de ltar snang ba'i phyir/ thog mtha' med pa'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas pas ston pa gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'o/

/gnyis pa des gsung pa rgyud kyi che ba la gnyis las/ spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa kun las mchog tu 'phags te/ tshul gsum pa'i sgron ma las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med phyir dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pas/ thabs 'phags pa bzhin du thabs des che ba'i shes rab kyang 'phags pa dang*/ dus myur bas byang chub 'grub pa dang*/ blang dor mi dgos pas lam bde ba dang*/ ye nas dag pas 'bad rtsol chung ba dang*/ gcig tu 'chad pas 'jug pa bde ba la sogs pa du mas 'phags shing che ba'o/ /khyad par du 'di nyid gsang sngags rgyud lung kun gyi 'phro gzhi yin pas kyang gzhan las khyad par 'phags te/ le'u gsum par/ 'dul ba mdo sde chos mngon dang*/ /dam tshig bsgrub dang grub pa dang*/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud/ /phyogs bcu rnams su rab grags pa/ / gsang ba'i snying po las 'phros te/ /zhes so/ /lam kun gyi 'bras bu yin pas kyang 'phags te/ bcu gsum par/ bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed du/ / shin tu sbyang la rab gnas shing*/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsnyen pa yi/ / 'bras bu gsang sngags 'di yin te/ /zhes so/ /'di nyid nges don kun gyi snying po yin zhing*/ tshe gcig gis grol bas kyang khyad par du 'phags te/ de nyid las/ 'di ni gsang chen nges pa yi/ /'bras bu lam du gyur pa yin/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /'di las gsang ba'i nges don med/ ces gsungs so/ /gsum pa che ba de dang ldan pa'i rgyud ji ltar bshad cing nyan pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ 'chad pa po slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ nyan pa po slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ de gnyis kyis gtan la dbab bya rgyud kyi don dngos bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ che ba/ ji ltar gdams pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bkod pa chen po yid bzhin mchog gi rgyud las/

mkhas shing bya ba bral ba dang*/ /chos nyid don la tshad phebs dang*/ /'dod pa'i don la rmongs pa med/ /gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ / dam tshig la gnas shing*/ phyi nang gi sgrub pa thams cad la mkhas pa/ slob ma'i shes rgyud byin gyis rlob cing grol bar nus pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi don la drod rtags thon cing*/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang bral ba zhig gi mtshan nyid tshang ba'o/ /'di ltar thun mong gi theg pa las kyang*/ bshes gnyen zhi ba dul ba nyer zhi ba/ yon tan brtson byas lhag par lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs la smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs la bsten/ /ces so/ /zhar la mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa yang*/ yon tan de dag dang mi ldan cing*/ khyad par de nyid las/ mtshan nyid mi ldan slob dpon ni//shes chung nga rgyal che ba dang*/ /dam tshig sdom pa rab 'chal zhing*//sngags kyi lta spyod nyams pa dang*/ /snying rje mi ldan rnyed pa 'tshol/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma de'i che ba ni/ kun tu bzang po dngos yin par le'u tha ma las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya gsang chen snying po 'di/ /rtogs nas smra ba gang byed pa/ /de nyid nga yin dbang yang rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ji ltar gdams tshul ni/ le'u bcu gsum pa las/ snod ldan ngang tshul bzang la brtan/ /lus dang longs spyod gtong la sbyin/ / gzhan du nam yang sbyin mi bya/ /rmongs dang 'phyar la gal te sbyin/ /dus min par ni srog zad nas/ /bsreg dang sbrebs la yun ring gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ rgya chen chos kyi snod gyur pa/ /dman pa'i chos la sbyar mi bya/ /dman la'ang mchog gi chos mi bshad/ /ces pas snod brtags la bshad par bya'o/ /ci'i phyir na rang gzhan la nyes pa chen po bskyed pa'i phyir dang*/ rmad byung rgyal po las/ slob ma ma brtags slob dpon dgra/

/'di phyir gnod cing yun ring 'tshe/ /zhes pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ che ba/ ji ltar nyan pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyir dad pa dang dam tshig ldan pa/ gtong phod dang sri zhu che ba/ chos dang bla ma la gus pa/ gsang thub cing sgrub pa la brtson pa ste/ snga ma las/ gsang sngags slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ bla ma la gus sri zhur ldan/ /dad dang ngo tsha khrel yod che/ /gsang thub bsgrub la brtson pa'o/ / zhes pa'o/ /khyad par du sngar thos bsam la sbyangs pa'i shes rab yod cing chos 'di'i snod du gyur pa ste/ 'di nyid las/ thos bsam sgom la rab sbyangs pa'i/ /shes rab mchog ldan rnams kyis zungs/ /snod ldan ngang tshul bzang la brtan/ /lus dang longs spyod gtong la sbyin/ /ces so/ 'di dang mthun par theg pa thun mong gi gzhung las kyang*/ bla ma la gus tshul khrims yongs dag dang*/ /bsam gtan dang ni 'don la rtag brtson dang*/ /grim zhing dul la bzod dang ldan pa ste/ /sdom brtson gnas pa'i chos ldan lags par gsungs/ zhes so/ zhar la de las bzlog pa ni/ snod ma yin la khyad par du sdom pa dang dam tshig 'chal zhing*/ chos dang bla ma la mi gus pa/ grogs dang mched lcam la smod pa ste/ yang dag pa'i lam la rmongs shing*/ sgo gsum khrel bag med pa/ rnam g.yeng dang mi dge ba la 'phyar ba ni spang bya ste/ 'di nyid las/ rmongs dang 'phyar la gal te byin/ /dus min par ni srog zad nas/ /bsreg dang sbrebs la yun ring gnas/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa snod ldan gyi che ba ni/ 'di nyid las/ gang zhig 'di la mos gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi/ /phyogs dus kun nas thams cad du// dkyil 'khor ma lus bsnyen pa yis/ /nye ba'i sras su dgongs par 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i rigs mchog 'dzin pa de/ /'jig rten gtso dang 'khor gyis bkur/ dam pa mchog dang dam pa yis/ /sras dang spun dgongs byin gyis rlobs/

/bde gshegs nyid kyi yul la zhugs/ /'jigs med kun tu bzang por sbyor/ /zhes pa dang*/ de ni nges par lung bstan te/ /sras ni thugs las skyes pa yin/ /sa rab rig 'dzin sa la gnas/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ snod kyi skyon gsum/ dri ma drug dang bral bas legs par nyan pa ste/ skyon gsum ni/ tshig don cung zad mi gnyer ba kha sbubs lta bu dang*/ cung zad zin na'ang mi brtan par zhabs rdol ba lta bu dang*/ zin yang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por mi 'gro bar grogs su 'gyur ba dug can lta bu gsum dang bral bas nyan pa ste/ yum bar ma las/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang*/ ngas bshad do/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /legs par ni dug can dang*/ rab tu nyon ni kha sbubs dang*/ yid la zungs shig ni zhabs rdol la gdams pa'o/ /dri ma drug ni/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang*/ /don du gnyer ba med nyid dang*/ /phyi rol rnam g.yeng nang du sdud/ /skyo bas nyan pa dri ma yin/ /zhes pa ste/ slob dpon dang grogs las nga lhag snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ slob dpon dang chos dang mched grogs rnams la ma dad pa dang*/ chos la 'dod 'dun dang don gnyer med pa dang*/ dbang po yul gyi phyir 'brang zhing rtse gcig tu mi 'jog pa dang*/ sems bying rmugs kyis nang du sdud pa dang*/ 'chad nyan gyi tshe 'dis ci byed snyam du bdud kyis bcos pa'i skyo bas nyan pa rnams ni/ tshe 'dir yang tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i chos la bar du gcod cing*/ phyi mar yang chos dang mi 'phrad pa'i nyes pas 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams par 'gyur bas rab tu gus pas spyod lam bsdam zhing legs pa'i tshul gyis so/ /gnyis ka la thun mong du 'doms pa'i tshul ni/ chos spyod thams cad kyi man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud las/ dang po byang chub sems bskyed do/

/rang nyid sgrol mar bsgom byas nas/ /rna ba g.yas par padma bsam/ /slob dpon 'jam dpal bsgoms byas nas/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi 'od zer dag /padmar nges par thim par bya/ /'gro rnams lha mor bsgoms byas nas/ /thon khar mi rtog stong pa nyid/ /skad cig gnyis tsam bsgom par bya/ /zhes pas/ slob dpon 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i zhal nas chos kyi gsung 'od zer du thon pas/ rang nyid de'i yum sgrol mar gyur pa'i rna ba g.yas par thim pas tshig don gyis lus gang dri ma dag par bsam zhing*/ chos thon dus chos thun 'go zhabs 'gyur bas kyang mi rtag pa mtshon zhing*/ de'i rang zhin stong par bsam pa'i ngang nas bsngo ba bya zhing sgyu ma lta bus thun mtshams 'da' bar bya'o// de'ang 'chad pa pos chos bstan pa ni sbyin pa/ nyon mongs pa med pas tshul khrims/ chos bstan pa la skyo ngal dang gnod 'tshe bzod pas bzod pa/ spro bas brtson 'grus/ chos 'chad pa las gzhan du ma yengs pas bsam gtan/ tshig don 'byed pas shes rab ste pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs shing*/ nyan pa pos kyang chos 'chad pa'i stan dang mchod pa chu dang me tog la sogs pa 'bul bas sbyin pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi ma dag pa rkang pa brkyang pa la sogs pa ste/ spyod 'jug las/ skyil krung 'dug dang rgyab mi bstan/ / gdugs dang mkhar ba mtshon thogs dang*/ /mgo bo dkris pa dag la min/ / zhes pa la sogs pa nas/ sgra che chung mi bya ba'i bar ni lus bsdam pa dang*/ ca co dang shub bu zlos res byed pa la sogs mi bya ba ni ngag gi nyes pa dang*/ sems kyi nyon mongs pa dang ma dad pa la sogs bsdam pa ni tshul khrims so/ /chos gral du lhags pa'i 'bu sbrang la sogs pa la mi 'tshe zhing shig la sogs pa'i gnod pa che chung bzod pa dang*/ chos ston pa la gsol ba 'debs shing nyan par brtson pa ni brtson 'grus dang*/ sems ma yengs bar nyan cing thos pa 'dzin pa ni bsam gtan dang*/

rang gis rtogs pa'i don la dpyod pa dang the tshom gyi gzhir gyur na bla ma la dri zhing rtsod pas rnam par gtan la dbab pa ni shes rab ste/ de nyid las/ me tog stan sogs rab 'bul zhing*/ /sa phyogs spyod lam bsdam pa dang*/ /srog chags rnams la 'tshe mi byed/ /bla ma la ni gsol ba 'debs/ /ma yengs bla ma'i gdams ngag 'dzin/ /dogs sel phyir na skyon tshig 'dri/ /sgrol ma yan lag drug dang ldan/ /zhes so/ yang na snang ba thams cad 'og min gyi zhing khams/ chos sgar de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa/ bla ma nyid gtso bo rigs lnga lus gcig la zhal phyogs bzhi gang du bltas kyang der lta bas theg pa chen po'i sgra sgrogs pa'i gsung gi 'od zer/ 'khor rnams zhi khro gang mos kyi tshom bur gsal ba'i rna bar bzhugs pas rtogs pa bskyed cing*/ gsung yi ge'i sprin las phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad du chos kyi gsung dbyangs rgya mtshos sems cad thams cad kyi mun pa bsal zhing don byas par bsam mo/ /thon kar snang srid lha dang gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin du gsal btab la/ bden pa dbyer med pa'i ngang las bsngo ba byas la langs te sgyu ma'i ngang nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams bya'o/ /'di dag ni gnad dam pa'o/ /gsum pa de gnyis kyis gtan la dbab bya rgyud kyi don dngos gtan la dbab pa la gnyis te/ rgyud gsum spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ gsang chen don gyi rim pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ ldang tshad do/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dngos sam dngos kyi bdag rkyen las bka' byin gyis brlabs pa gang zhig /'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa yin te/ rdo rje las/ gsungs so bstan no byin gyis brlabs/ /rab 'byams theg pa'i snying po mchog /rang bzhin rab tu 'brel ba'i phyir/ /rgyud ces nges par bzhag pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ka ye nas sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/

de'i rang bzhin gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid 'dir 'dus pa kho na'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ phyi ma'i rgyud/ phyi ma phyi ma'i rgyud do/ /dang po ni/ gzhung gzhan la ma brten par gzhan bskyed par nus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ de'i don rgyas par ston pa gnyis pa'o/ /ma tshang ba kha skong ba gsum pa'o/ /yang rtsa ba/ bshad rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma gsum du'ang bstan te/ dang po ni sngar bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni rgyud rang gis rgyud gzhan gyi don 'grel bar byed pa bshad pa dang*/ de gnyis nas mi gsal ba gsal bar ston pa ma tshang ba kha skong bas rgyud phyi ma zhes bzhed de/ snga ma dang don gcig go /de ltar gsum las/ 'di ni sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po ste/ 'di la kha cig gis/ zhi ba'i bstod pa yan chad rtsa ba'i rgyud/ man chad la phyi ma'i rgyud zer ba ni rigs par ma mthong ste/ thams cad rtsa ba'i rgyud yin par bstan pa dang*/ rgyud las kyang de ltar ma phyes pa dang*/ zhi khro gnyis su byung ba ni rgyud gzhan thams cad kyi rtsa bar bstan pa yin gyi/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor zhi ba'i g.yon du bstan pa'i rnam dbye de ni shin tu 'gal bar mthong ngo*/ /gsum pa ldang tshad ni/

rgyud de nyid bya ba gzhan gyi 'phro gzhir 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan la de'i cho ga mi ltos na rgyud chen po zhes bya ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di bzhin no/ gzhan las 'phros shing gzhan du ltos na yan lag gi rgyud dam bkol ba dum bu'i rgyud ces bya ste/ rgyud chung ngu'o/ /dper na rtse mo rigs bsdus bzhin no/ /rgyud so so'i ldang tshad ni/ rang gi lam thabs mchog la brten nas nyon mongs pa rang sar dag cing*/ dngos grub gnyis sgrub pa'i rang bzhin 'brel chags pa ni rgyud du bkod pa tsam so so'i tshad do/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum kyang rang rang gi ngo bo zam ma chad cing*/ thabs mchog gi gzhi dang*/ lam dang*/ 'bras bur gnas pas rgyud ces rnam par bzhag go /'di dag la yi ge mi 'dra ba shin tu mang bas 'dir ma bris so/ gnyis pa gsang chen don gyi rim pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum ste/ gzhi dang lam dang*/ 'bras bu'i rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /de skad du'ang rdo rje las/ gzhi dang lam dang ngo bo yis/ nges pa rnam pa gsum du gsungs/ / zhes so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gnas lugs don gyi gzhi dang*/ rtogs pa lam gyi gzhi'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gzhi'i gnas lugs/ snang tshul/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ye nas 'od gsal ba'i sems nyid kyi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gsum du sangs rgyas shing dngos po dang mtshan ma gang yang ma grub pa ste/ 'di nyid las/ rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /pho mo ma yin ma ning min/ /mtshan med ma yin rigs brgyud min/ /kha dog ma yin dbyibs ma yin/ /gnas su ma yin gang yang min/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /zhes pa dang*/ yang*/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi gang nas kyang*/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnyed mi 'gyur/ sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du ma tshol cig /ces gsungs pas/ 'di'i don nges par bya ba la dpe don rtags gsum las/

sems nyid rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i dpe ston ka'i nam mkha' sprin thams cad dang bral ba lta bu ste dngos po dang mtshan ma med pa'o/ /don ni sems nyid gang du'ang ma grub cing smra bsam brjod pa thams cad las 'das pa rang byung gi ye shes so/ /rtags ni dran rig sna tshogs su gsal ba 'di nyid yin te/ gzhig rtsa dang ngos bzung med pa/ kha dog dang dbyibs mtshan med la snang ba 'dis mtshon pa'o/ /de skad du'ang kun byed las/ nga yi rang bzhin shes 'dod na/ /dpe ni nam mkha' lta bur ltos/ /don ni kun tu skye ba med/ /rtags ni rig pa byang chub sems/ /zhes so/ /de'ang med pa phyang chad du ma song bas gsal la ngos bzung med pa rgya mtsho rnyogs dwangs pa'i gting lta bu/ yod pa mtha' gcig tu ma grub pas dpe ston ka'i nam mkha' lta bu/ yon tan lhun gyis grub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu ste/ rgya mtsho las/ nam mkha' rgya mtsho rin chen sogs/ /nye ba'i dpe yis mtshon pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de'ang ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pas ka dag ces bya la/ yon tan ye nas rdzogs pas lhun grub ces bya ste/ ngo bo gcig la rang bzhin gnyis su med pa chu dang chu zla'i tshul te/ rgyas pa las/ thams cad dag ces bya ba yang*/ /dngos po bsal dag ma yin te// snang spyod nyid na rnam par dag /rang rig ye shes gzugs su skyes/ /sku dang ye shes bsam mi khyab/ /ces so/ /dbye na/ ka dag dang lhun grub gnyis po la/ dbyings/ ye shes/ gnyis su med pa gsum gsum du 'dod de/ snga ma las/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /lhun gyis grub dang rnam dag pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de la dbyings ka dag ni sems nyid ye nas dag pa'o/ /ye shes ka dag ni rig pa skyes sam gnas dus nyid nas ngo bo med pa'o/ / gnyis med ka dag ni gang snang ba nyid las tha dad pa'i chos nyid ma grub pa'o/ de bzhin du/ dbyings lhun grub ni ye nas 'od gsal ba'i sems nyid sus kyang ma byas par gdod ma nas dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par yod pa ste/

le lag las/ 'das dang da ltar byung ba dang*/ /'byung bar ma nges dus 'di dag /snga phyi med par mnyam yin te/ /zhes so/ /ye shes lhun grub ni dkyil 'khor gsum dang cir snang thams cad ye shes kyi rol par shar ba nyid/ sus kyang ma byas par ye shes nyid rang snang bar 'dod de/ rdo rje las/ chos kun ye nas dag pa yi/ /ye shes nyid la nyid snang ba/ /sus kyang ma byas rang byung bar/ /ye nyid nas ni lhun grub pa'o/ /zhes so/ gnyis med lhun grub ni de ltar ye shes su snang ba yang rtag pa bden pa'i rang bzhin ma yin te/ chu zla'am gzugs brnyan ltar snang la ngo bos stong par 'dod pa ni/ rgyas pa las/ 'di ltar thams cad gzugs brnyan te/ /bya byed snang zhing dngos po med/ /chu zla'i tshul du thams cad gnas/ /thams cad snang la rang bzhin med/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa snang tshul ni/ gzhi de lta bu las ma rig pa bdag tu 'dzin byed kyi blo rtog pa langs pas 'gro ba so sor snang ba rmi lam lta bu ste/ 'di las/ e ma ho bde gshegs snying po las/ /rang gi rnam rtog las kyis sprul/ /ces so/ /de ltar snang dus 'di nyid na ngos bzung med de/ las rim las/ 'khor ba gzugs brnyan 'dra ba yis/ /rang bzhin ye nas mya ngan 'das/ /zhes so/ de'ang sems can gyi dus na/ sems kyi snang ba yul dang rnam pa sna tshogs snang ba dung la ser por 'dzin pa lta bu nyid/ 'khrul pa dag tshe sangs rgyas la ye shes kyi snang ba sku dang zhing khams su snang ba yang*/ sngar gyi gzhi phung po khams dang skye mched dag pa las gyur pa ste/ dung ser po nyid bad kan dag pas dkar por snang ba bzhin no/ /gsum pa dbye ba la gsum ste/ don dam pa/ kun rdzob/ dbyer med pa'o/ /de skad du lam rim las/ de yang rnam gsum tshul du bzhag/ ces so/ /dang po ni/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba ste/ rgyas pa las/ chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/

/de bzhin nyid dang stong ba'i mtha'/ /yang dag nyid dang chos kyi dbyings/ /mtshan nyid med cing dmigs su med/ /ces so/ de'ang chos thams cad rig pas gzhig cing brtags na gang gi ngo bor ma grub cing*/ snang dus nyid nas skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral bar gnas te/ 'di nyid las/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*/ /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes pa nyid na skye ba med/ /ces pa'i 'don pa bsgyur te/ 'gags pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ 'gro 'ong med pa'i bar du gsungs shing*/ rigs pas kyang grub ste/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos 'di dag chos can/ rang bzhin bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med de/ bden pa'i gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i phyir/ ces gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs la sogs pas kyang shes so/ /mdor na ji ltar sna ba de'i rang bzhin gdod ma nas ngo bo med pa ni don dam pa'i gnas lugs so/ /gnyis pa kun rdzob la gsum ste/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ rang bzhin no/ /dang po ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos ma 'gags sna tshogs su gsal ba 'di yin no/ /dbye na gnyis te/ yang dag kun rdzob dang*/ log pa'i kun rdzob bo/ /dang po ni/ 'khrul pa dag pa'i tshe thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi rol par snang ba yin te/ 'di nyid las/ ye shes nyid la ye shes rol/ /ye shes rol pa nyid kyang gsog /ces pa dang*/ lam rim las/ yang dag nyid du grags so cog /gnyis snang nyid nas gang yin pa/ /sems nyid ye shes sgyu mar shar/ /snang ba ngo bo nges med cing*/ /ji ltar bltas pa'i snang ba dang*/ /rang bzhin ther zug rtag chad bral/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang ji snyed pa thams cad de/ de nyid las/ de la log rtog sgyu ma ni/ /chos dang bdag dang dngos po rnams/ /ngo bo yod sogs rtog pa las/ /rtogs pa sgyu ma'i klong gyur pas/ /skyes kyang mi bden bslu ba grub/

/ces so/ /gsum pa rang bzhin la gnyis te/ ye shes sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang*/ log rtog sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ /dang po ni/ 'og min gyi zhing khams na longs sku'i snang ba dang*/ de las 'phros pa'i sprul pa ste/ 'ja' tshon nam chu zla ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa dus thams cad pa'i ngo bor gnas shing*/ rgyu rkyen rang rgyud pas ma bskyed par 'dod de/ gzhi nas de ltar gnas pa gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'gro ba'i sems snang rmi lam lta bu ste/ de'ang sems kyi bag chags las phyi rol don gzhan gyis bskyed pa'i rgyu 'bras su mi 'dod de/ rang gi rnam rtog las kyis sprul/ /ces so/ /'di nam bzlog na/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ srid gsum 'di ni rmi lam dang*/ smig sgyu chu yi phung po bzhin/ /nor bar mthong nas phyir bzlog go /zhes so/ gsum pa dbyer med pa ni/ log rtog sgyu ma dang*/ yang dag sgyu ma gnyis ka'i tshe'ang*/ rang gi snang ba de dang de'i rang bzhin stong pa la chu dang zla gzugs ltar dbyer med pa yin te/ 'di nyid las/ yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul gnyis su/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan med de/ /rnam dag dbyings nyid tshul gcig go /zhes so/ /de'ang sgyu ma 'di gnyis gcig gam tha dad/ gcig na dag ma dag so sor bzhag tu med pa dang*/ phan tshun 'chol bar snang bar 'gyur zhing*/ mi gcig na sems nyid gcig gi rang bzhin ma yin par 'gyur ro zhe na/ lan la gnyis las/ tshul mtshungs pa ni/ rmi lam gyi 'khrul snang dang*/ nyin snang gi ma 'khrul ba 'di gnyis tha snyad du gcig gam tha dad/ gcig na nyin mtshan gyi snang ba tha dad du so sor bzhag tu med pa dang*/ nyin snang bzhin du rmi lam yang ma 'khrul ba dang*/ rmi lam bzhin du nyin snang yang ma 'khrul par 'gyur pas phan tshun 'chol ba'i skyon yod cing*/ tha dad na'ang sems gcig la snang ba'i rang bzhin ma yin par 'gyur ro zhe na lan ci yod/ de sems su ngo bo gcig la dus kyi tha dad zhe na/

mtshungs te/ rig par ngo bo gcig kyang rkyen 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi gnas skabs so sor snang zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa lan dngos ni/ dung ser por 'dzin dus nas dkar por gnas pa de'i phyir/ ser por ma grub pas dkar po dang gcig tha dad du ma grub pa ltar/ 'khrul par snang dus nyid nas ma 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin ye nas dag par gnas pas/ ngo bo gcig pa dang tha dad pa gang du'ang bzhag tu med do/ /de bzhin du tho yor la mir 'khrul dus nyid nas thor gnas pas/ tho yor dang mi la ngo bo gcig pa dang tha dad du bzhag tu med pa bzhin no/ /tshul 'di ltar 'khor ba nyid mya ngan las 'das par 'khrul pa gzhi dang rtsa ba med cing*/ don la mi gnas par bstan pa ste/ 'di las/ ngo mtshar sku gsum yon tan zhing khams yang*/ /gzhan na med de de nyid de ltar yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ log rtog rgyu 'bras rgyun nyid kyang*/ /gzhi rtsa med dbyings skad cig ma/ /rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nyid tshul/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ /sa chu spyan dang mā ma kī/ /me rlung gos dkar sgrol ma ste/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas zhing*/ thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi brnyes so/ /zhes so/ /de'ang dung dkar por snang ba 'di bar skabs su ser por snang ba ltar 'khrul par snang yang*/ gzung 'dzin dag pa na 'khrul snang 'di nyid ye shes su dag ste/ dung ser snang dkar por dag pa bzhin sangs rgyas so/ /'di la gnas gyur zhes btags kyang gnas gyur ma yin te snang ba de ltar gnas pa'o/ /dung ser po nyid dkar por gnas gyur pa med de/ dang po nas dkar por gnas pa bzhin du/ 'khrul snang rtog tshogs dang bcas pa 'di nyid dang po nas sangs rgyas pas/ de las logs shig tu gnas spos pa bzhin gnas gyur mi 'thad cing 'di'i dgongs pa ma yin no/

/de la rgyu yi theg pas kun rdzob 'dus byas mi rtag cing bslu bar 'dod de/ de ltar na longs sku'ang bslu bar thal te/ gzugs sku gnyis kun rdzob pas bsdus pa'i phyir dang*/ mi rtag par thal ba las/ 'gro grol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad rtag /ces kho rang gi grub mtha' nang 'gal ba yin no/ /'dir ni log rtog sgyu ma'i kun rdzob ma rig pas bskyed pa'i rgyu 'bras yin pas mi rtag pa dang bslu bar 'dod la/ yang dag sgyu ma ni dang po nyid nas de ltar gzhi la lhun gyis grub pa lam gyis phyin ci log dag pa na sngar thog tu phebs pas dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med de/ rgyu rkyen gyis gsar du 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ tshul 'di rnams byams pas kyang bshad de/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min dang*/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces so/ /des na 'dir chos thams cad bden pa dbyer med du ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don ni gnas lugs don gyi gzhi'o/ /gnyis pa rtogs pa lam gyi gzhi la gsum ste/ gnas lugs/ snang lugs/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas lugs kyi gzhi de nyid blos phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa ste/ rdo rje las/ rang bzhin gnas pa'i gzhi de ni/ / rtogs pa rnal 'byor lam gyi gzhi/ /zhes so/ de'ang ma rtogs na gzhi des kun la khyab kyang gshis su gnas pa tsam las don byed mi nus te tha mal pa'i sems can la gnas pa bzhin no/ /de nyid rtogs pa las lam bsgom pa'i gzhi byed pas don 'grub pa rnal 'byor pa'i lam gyi gzhi zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ de nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa shas chung bas thar pa la nye ba dang*/ tha mal gyi snang ba ma dag pa dngos su ma log kyang sems can gzhan las khyad par du 'phags te/ dper na rmi lam du dgra dang g.yang sa la sogs pa 'jigs pa shar dus/

rmi lam du shes pa dang*/ ma shes pa gnyis ka la snang ba de ma log par mtshungs kyang*/ sdug bsngal la khyad yod de/ rmi lam du ma shes na de'i bar nyin dus dang khyad med pa tsam myong dgos la/ de nyid rmi lam yin par shes pa rnams la snang ba de dngos su ma log kyang sdug bsngal rang mtshan pa med pa bzhin du/ phyi nang gi 'khrul snang rang mtshan du zhen pa'i 'gro ba rnams la gnas skabs su bde sdug rang mtshan pa yod cing*/ yun ring por 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i nyes pa yod la/ rnal 'byor pa chos thams cad kyi gzhi'am gshis bden pa dbyer med du rtogs na rnam rtog dang mtshan 'dzin shas chung bas/ gnas skabs su bde sdug la spang blang dang zhen 'dzin rang mtshan pa med cing*/ myur du 'khor ba myang 'das su grol bar nges pa bden med sgyu mar snang ba zhes bya'o/ /'di'i snang ba dang sems sgyu ma gnyis po gang gi nang du 'du na/ 'khrul snang dang zhen rtog gi cha rnams ni log rtog sgyu ma nyid du 'dus/ so so rang gi rig pa'i lta ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ ye shes rnams ni yang dag sgyu mar 'du ste/ phyin ci log gi blo las 'das pa'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bla ma rong pa'i bzhed kyis/ gnas skabs phyin ci log gi sgyu ma snang yang nges par mi gol mi srid pas yang dag sgyu ma'i sa la gtogs par bsdu ste/ lcags kyus zin pa'i nya chu nang na gnas kyang skam sar gtogs pa bzhin no zhes gsung ngo*/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ mnyam pa nyid bzhi/ dag pa gsum/ rtogs pa bzhi'i gtan tshigs kyis gnas lugs kyi gzhi rtogs pa lam gyi gzhir bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mnyam gnyis lhag pa'i mnyam gnyis kyis/ /zhes pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad chos can/ ye nas dag mnyam rdzogs pa chen por gnas pa yin te/ gdod ma nas mnyam pa nyid bzhi'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i phyir ro/ de la thun mong gi mnyam pa gnyis dang*/

lhag pa'i mnyam pa gnyis so/ /dang po theg pa thun mong gi 'dod pa'i bden pa gnyis kyis gzhal bas kyang mnyam ste/ snang tsam nyid nas rang bzhin ma grub pa'i phyir/ sgyu ma lta bur chos thams cad mnyam ste/ rnam bkod las/ thun mong rgyu yi kun rdzob tu/ /rkyen bzhi 'dus tsam sgyu ma tsam/ /zhes so/ /don dam par gang du'ang ma grub pa'i phyir chos thams cad mnyam ste/ de nyid las/ kun brtags spros pa bcas pa'i phyir/ /rnam grangs don dam zhes kyang bya/ /de la rgyu rkyen cha dbye bas/ /'dus snang dngos po ma skyes la/ /don dam mnyam par 'dod pa ste/ /rten cing 'brel bas sgrub pa'i mtha'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa la grags pa'i bden pa gnyis kyis gzhal na'ang chos thams cad mnyam nyid du gnas pa las/ dang po kun rdzob sgyu mar mnyam pa ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad chos can/ bzang ngan blang dor grub pa med de/ snang ba sgyu mar dag cing de'i rang bzhin bden med las 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid las/ kun rdzob sgyu mar snang ba ni/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du thams cad snang*/ /'di dag thams cad gzugs brnyan te/ thams cad snang la rang bzhin med/ /ces so/ /don dam skye 'gags med pa'i phyir/ mnyam pa nyid du gnas te/ de nyid las/ don dam skye 'gags med pa ste/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /de bzhin nyid dang stong pa'i mtha'/ /yang dag nyid dang chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes so/ /de'ang theg pa 'og ma ltar kun rdzob skye 'gags byed la don dam mi byed pa ltar ma yin te/ gnas lugs la kun rdzob kyang snang dus nyid nas don dam dang dbyer med pas/ skye 'gags mi byed par 'dod de/ rnam bkod las/ don dam kun rdzob dbyer med ni/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /gzhi rtsa med las thams cad byung*/ /med dang yod pa gnyis ka min/ /don dam kun rdzob dbyeramed de/ /'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas

snang*/ /dngos med de nyid sna tshogs pa'i/ /de nyid sgyu ma mig yor tshul/ / zhes pa dang*/ 'di nyid las/ 'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas rdo rje dkyil 'khor 'byin pa'i dam/ /zhes pa dang*/ bden pa gnyis kar dbyer med pas/ /'phrul dga'i tshul te tha dad min/ /zhes so/ log rtog sgyu ma'ang rmi lam bzhin du skye 'gag tu snang yang skye 'gag tu don la ma grub pas kun rdzob skye 'gag grub par mi 'gyur zhing*/ yang dag sgyu ma dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pas skye 'gags mi byed pa kho nar 'dod do/ /tshul 'di nyid slob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang bshad de/ /bden pa gnyis char du'ang rang bzhin yod min pas/ /'di dag rtag pa ma yin chad ma yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*/ /'gags pa med pa skye med pa/ /chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa yin no/ gnyis pa ni/ snod bcud rgyud rnams dag rtogs shing*/ /zhes pas/ chos thams cad chos can/ ye nas mnyam rdzogs gcig tu gnas pa yin te/ dag pa gsum du gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /de la snod yum lngar dag /bcud kyi phung po lnga yab lngar dag /rgyud kyi rtog tshogs brgyad byang chub sems dpar dag pa'o/ /'di dag gi rang bzhin sngar bstan zin mod kyi 'on kyang cung mi 'dra bas lung gzhan dang mtshungs par bshad na/

rnam bkod las/ rgyu yi mtshan nyid dag pa ni/ /phyi rol chen po lnga rnams te/ /sems nyid gzung 'dzin gnyis snang ba/ /gzung ba'i yul nyid 'byung ba che/ /rgyu nyid rang gi sems yin pas/ /'byung ba chen po rgyud las dag /yum gyi rang bzhin nyid du gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ zla ba rus pa rdo rje/ sha rin po che/ dri chen de bzhin gshegs pa/ dri chu las/ nyi ma khrag padma'i rigs te yab lngar dag pa de nyid las/ 'bras bu yongs su dag pa na/ /sems can kun gyi rus pa de/ /rdo rje byang chub sems yin no/ /sha ni padma'i rakta yin/ /dri chen dri chu gur gum chu/ /so so'i lus la gnas pa dag /don dam dmigs med dag pa yis/ /phyi nang chos rnams thams cad kyang*/ /rang gi ngo bor ma yin te/ / skye 'gags med par ye nas dag /ces pa dang*/ rtog tshogs rgyud ni sems dpa' che/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa rtogs pa bzhi'i gtan tshigs ni/ rtogs pa bzhis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad chos can/ rnal 'byor bas dag mnyam rdzogs pa chen por dbang 'byor pa yin te/ de dag gi rang bzhin rtogs pa bzhir blos nges pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang 'di nyid las/ rgyu gcig pa dang y-ig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum par/ /rab tu rtogs pa rnam bzhi yis/ /thams cad mngon rdzogs rgyal po che/ /zhes so/ /chos thams cad bden pa dbyer med du yes nas dag par rgyu gcig pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge'i sprin du ye nas gnas shing ma skyes par gcig pa dang*/ de dag kyang skudang ye shes kyi rang bzhin du ye nas sangs rgyas pas byin gyi rlabs shing*/ bla mas kyang dbang la sogs pas lam du byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ de dag kyang ji ltar gnas pa bzhin bstan pa'i gnas lugs rang gi yid ches par mngon sum du rtogs pa bzhi'i ngo bor khong du chud pa ni/ gshis kyi gzhi lam gyi gzhir 'grub par byed pa'i gtan tshigs so/

/de ltar chos thams cad snang stong gnyis su med pas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtogs pas/ rtag chad kyi mtha' las grol ba dang*/ tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa dang*/ lam la gol sa med pa dang*/ thar pa byang chub tu nges pa dang*/ ngan 'gror mi ltung zhing bzang 'gror brgyud pa dang*/ las kyi nyes pas mi gos pa dang*/ theg pa dman pa las grol ba dang*/ dngos po dang mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa dang*/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa la sogs pa'i yon tan tshad med de/ lam rim las/ gang zhig 'di 'drar mthong rtogs pa/ /dngos grub mchog gi snying po ste/ /chu srin phyag rgya ji bzhin du/ /dang po don rtogs mthar mi gtong*/ /rgya mtsho dwangs pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar/ /sgra rten yid la byed min par/ /rang rig mngon sum dmigs bral ba/ /rang gsal gsum bral mi 'gul bas/ /nges par gding du gang byas pa/ /thos bsam brtan pa'i lta mthar phyin/ /de las mtshan ma 'byung ba ni/ /stobs kyi rtogs kyi rtogs pa'i rlung ldan la/ /'pho 'gyur mthong la 'jigs med cing*/ /'khrul pa'i khams la skyo ba med/ /grub pa'i gnas la mi smon to/ /zhes so/ /'pho 'gyur ni 'chi ba ste nyam mi nga'o/ /de dag gis gzhi bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa lam la gnyis te/ gang gis sgom pa gang zag gi mtshan nyid dang*/ gang bsgom pa lam dngos kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lam rim las/ de yang rang bzhin sbyangs pa yis/ /snod du gyur pa nye ring phyir/ /rim dang cig char bzhi cha yis/ /phye bas rnal 'byor chen por 'jug/ces pas/ rang bzhin gyi snod dang*/ sbyangs pa'i snod do/ dang po ni/ gzhi ye nas dbang po rnon por gyur pa ste/ kun byed las/ lha mi sems can dbang po mi mthun te/ /la la ye nas dbang po chig chod yod/ /la la dbang po sbyangs pa'i blo can yod/ /ces pa dang*/ mnyam sbyor las/ ngo bo nyid dang mthun dag dang*/ /rang bzhin gyis ni de grub bo/

/zhes pa dang*/ dgongs 'dus las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing khams na 'khod pa'i sems can de dag ni/ sems can gyi rang bzhin sna tshogs pa'i phyir/ blo shin tu zab pa dang*/ mi zab pa dang*/ yangs pa dang*/ dog pa dang*/ brtan pa dang*/ 'gyur ba dang*/ rnon po dang*/ rtul ba dang*/ myur ba dang*/ bul ba dang*/ che ba dang*/ chung ba sha stag gis gang bas gsang sngags kyi ngo bo nyid kyi gtam/ rim gyis pa dang*/ cig char du thos na de la mi skrag mi dngangs shing dga' ba dang*/ mgu ba dang*/ rangs par gyur pa'i phyir sna tshogs su snang ngo*/ zhes pa dang*/ thabs zhags las/ sems can de dag las rang bzhin gyi dbang po rnon po ni/ mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ thun mong gi mdo sde dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa las kyang*/ kha cig ni rang bzhin gyis dbang po rno ba yin la/ kha cig ni rtul por gnas te/ zhes pa dang*/ mdzod las kyang*/ kha cig dang po nas de'i rigs/ /kha cig sbyangs pa las gyur to/ /zhes pa la sogs pa byung bas/ gzhi nas dbang po la rno rtul yod cing*/ sbyangs pas kyang rtul po rnon por grol bar bshad do/ /'di nyid kyi rnon po ma hār 'jug tshul gnyis las/ cig char ba ni/ snga ma dang yang snga la sogs par theg pa gang la'ang ma sbyangs shing*/ 'dir yang theg pa gang du'ang ma sbyangs par ma hā dang a tir 'jug pa'o/ /rim gyis pa ni/ sngar gang du'ang ma zhugs ma sbyangs kyang*/ 'di la ma hā man chad gang rung la rim par gsum mam gcig tu zhugs pa'i rjes la a tir 'jug pa'o/ de ltar theg pa la zhugs ma zhugs kyis rim gyis pa dang*/ cig char ba zhes bya ste/ de gnyis ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i snang ba sku/ grags pa gsung*/ dran rig thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi don khong du chud cing grub pas/ dbang po rnon po lta ba yangs pa de nyid myur du grol te/ lam rim las/ la la dbang po rnon ba dag /theg pa chen por gnyis 'jug ste/

/ma sbyangs grub pa gsum phyir gyis/ /mtho brtan myur rno rgya che yangs/ /zab yangs rgyu yi gang zag de/ /nyid dang rkyen dang de rim pas/ /phye bas rgyu 'bras chen po rnams/ /ma nges 'jug dang 'di nyid du'o/ /zhes so/ /'dir rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' la rab tu rmongs shing*/ theg pa chen po'i phyogs la blo kha ma phyogs te/ phrag dog gi mun pa mi bzad pa dang*/ kun nas dkris pa'i khro gnyer rgyun ring bas rang gi dge tshogs ma rung par byed pa'i blo ngan dag na re/ gzhi nas dbang po la rno rtul mi rigs te/ thams cad rtul po sha stag yin pas sbyangs na der 'gyur gyi/ khyed kyis de skad brjod pa ni phyin ci log ces zer ro/ /de ltar na sbyangs kyang rtul po nyid du grub pa de/ rnon por 'gyur mi rigs te/ sol ba'i dngos po ji tsam sbyangs kyang gser du mi 'gyur ba bzhin/ zhes pa 'di la lan ci yod/ lung gis kyang gnod de/ phal po che las/ zhing rnams kun kyang sna tshogs te/ / la la rin chen rnam par bkra/ /kha cig nyon mongs kun gyi gnas/ sems can kun kyang tha dad de/ /kha cig sems dge rab dwangs shing*/ /dbang po mchog dang rab ldan te/ /la la mi shes kun nas rmongs/ /gzhi ni rang bzhin tha dad cing*/ /rig pa bye brag so sor snang*/ /de bzhin mdog dbyibs bde sdug dang*/ /rang bzhin rgya mtsho'i tshad dang ldan/ /ces pa dang yang 'gal ba yin no/ /gnyis pa sbyangs ba'i snod ni/ tshe rabs nas theg pa sna tshogs la sbyangs pa'o/ /de la'ang gnyis las/ sbyangs pa'i ṛm gyis ba ni/ snga ma dang yang snga la theg pa mtha' dag la sbyangs shing*/ 'dir yang kun la rim par zhugs shing sbyangs pa'i mthar a tir 'jug pa ste/ snga ma las/ de phyir ma nges rigs mtshon nas/ /mun pa'i shes pa de dag nyid/ /rang bzhin rgyu yi snyung bar gnas/ / phal pa'i sems brgyad mthar gnas tshe/ /lam stegs sngon du rdzogs par spyod/

/ces so/ /sbyangs pa'i cig char ba ni/ snga ma yang sngar kun la sbyangs pa zhig 'dir gang la'ang ma zhugs ma sbyangs bar a ti nyid la 'jug pa'o/ / snga ma las/ kha cig dus mtha' cig char ba/ /bskal pa rdul snyed sngon sbyangs pas/ /thun mong de nyid sbyangs pa'i mthar/ /rim gyis sbyangs la cig char bgrod/ /ces so/ /'di la glan rdo rje 'od ni/ sngon sbyangs 'di'i tshe stod theg pa chung ngu dang*/ theg pa chen po pha rol du phyin pa la sbyangs nas/ sngags phyi pa bor te 'jug par bzhed do/ /de ltar na cig char ba yang dag tu mi 'gyur ro//zhar lam du zhugs zin gyi dbang du byas nas cig char ba ni dus myur bar 'bras bu thob pa dang*/ lam snga ma kha cig bzhag nas phyi ma bsgom pa'ang yod la/ rim gyis pa ni rim pa ji skad bshad pa bzhin no/ /de dag kyang 'jug tshul gyis gnyis su bshad de/ chags pa can dang*/ chags pa bral ba'o/ /gnyis pa gang bsgom pa lam dngos kyi rim pa la gnyis te/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam mo/ /dang po ni/ ma nges pa'i rigs can 'ga' zhig 'og ma'i lam stegs sngon la ma bstan na mi 'jug pa yod srid pas/ de gzhug pa'i don du thun mong gi lam re zhig bstan te/ 'di nyid las/ sa rnams khyad par bkod pa yang*/ /gsang ba'i snying por 'gro ba'i lam/ /zhes pa dang/ theg pa bzhi yi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lam du 'jug pa'i tshul sems bskyed pa dang*/ lam dngos kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po thun mong gi theg pa las smon 'jug gnyis bshad pa ltar/ 'dir yang lam la 'jug pa rgyu'i sems bskyed dang*/ zhugs nas spyod pa 'bras bu'i sems bskyed gnyis su bshad de/ spyan 'grel las/ rang bzhin mngon bye rnal 'byor pa/ ngo bo rkyen gyi rnam par dbye/ /rigs dang rigs su nges pa yis/ /dang po rnam pa gnyis 'gyur pa/ /zhes so/ /dang po ni/ bla mas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sngon 'gror theg pa thun mong gi smon 'jug gnyis bskyed nas/

dbang bskur bas thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed de lam dang por tshud pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lam so so'i thabs dang*/ shes rab khyad par can gyi sems thams cad yin te/ snga ma las/ lam gyi ngo bo sems bskyed pa/ /rang rang thabs dang shes rab mchog /ces so/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lam gnyis kyi rim pa spyir bstan pa dang*/ lam so so'i rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ grol lam dang*/ thabs lam mo/ dang po ni/ gang zag las dang po pa'am chags bral rnams 'jug pa'i lam ste/ lha dang*/ mi rtog pa bsgom pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ gzhi bden pa dbyer med rtogs nas/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum tshang bas bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i lha bsgom pa'o/ /de'ang rim gyis dang skad cig bsgom pa'i gang zag gnyis so/ /gnyis pa mi rtog pa'ang*/ lus chos bdun ldan pas chos thams cad yul sems gnyis su med pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du 'jog pa ste/ 'di la'ang rang gsal gnyis med du skad cig gis 'jog pa dang*/ rim gyis bsgoms pas 'jog pa ste/ cig char ba dang rim gyis pa gnyis yod do/ /de skad du'ang lam rim las/ bsam bya bsam par mi bya ste/ mi bsam pa yang mi bsam mo/ /gang la rnam par mi bsam pa/ /de ni rang rig mnyam nyid do/ /zhes pa dang*/ bla ma las/ rim par de nyid gsal 'gyur 'brel/ / skabs kyi rdzogs pa chen por brjod/ /ces so/ gnyis pa thabs lam la/ rlung dang*/ thig le gnyis las/ so sor sbyong ba ni/ dang po rlung la brten nas thig le rnal 'byor du byed pa ste/ rtsa yung ba dang 'dra bar thig le chu dang 'dra ba rlung skyes bus rtsol bas drangs te/ lus kyi 'khor lo bzhi dang*/ de'i 'dab mas gzhi dang 'dra ba thams cad du khyab par bkram pa las/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi don gnyis 'grub pa'o/ /'di la gcig tu bsgom pa ni/ brtan pa thob nas bsres te bsgom pa'o/ /de 'ang dang po dbang rnams rdzogs par mnos la/

steng sgo'i 'khor lo drug dang*/ srog shing gsum dang*/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa dang*/ 'og sgo'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi bsgom pa las/ ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs can gsal la mi rtog pa dang*/ nyi zla'i gzugs can bde stong ngo bo stong pa dang*/ mchog dga'i gzugs can dbyer med lhun rdzogs chen po gsum rim pas thob pa ni rim gyis pa yin la/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dus gcig tu skyes pa ni cig char ba zhes bya'o//de'ang phyi gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang mnos/ snyigs ma'i rlung dang*/ phra ba'i rlung dang*/ ye shes kyi rlung dang*/ 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas lugs dang*/ de dag so so'i rtsa dang thig le 'od la sogs pa bsgom du gzhug /de brtan pa dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur/ thig le dbab pa dang*/ rdo rje'i bum par bzung ba'i thabs kyis 'gro 'ong la mkhas par bya ste/ sa bcu lam lnga pha rol tu phyin pa bcu/ dga' ba bcu drug gi ye shes su ngo sprad de/ yum zla ba can dang rol pa las shar ba'i ye shes ni don dam pa'i bden pa ste/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas steng sgo bsgom du bcug pa'i rjes la/ 'og sgo'i thig le bzlog pa la sogs pa'i gdams ngag brjod nas/ yum nyi ma can dang rol pa las shar ba'i ye shes ni bde ba chen po'i dbang ste/ bden pa dbyer med kyi ye shes shar ba'o/ /de nyid nyams su blangs pas rdo rje 'chang gi sa bgrod de/ zla gsang las/ 'dod chags med la byang chub med/ /sdig pa'i nang nas chags bral te/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgya mtsho las/ bye brag rlung las gyur pa yis/ /ye shes 'byung ba'i steng 'og sgo/ /dgug dang bkug pa'i thabs nyid de/ /'khor lo gsum gyi srog shing gsum/ /me rlung 'gro ba nam mkha'i ba/ /bzho bas steng du rnam par grags/ /bkug pa gsum gyis sems lnga'i rim/ /skyes pas bcu drug sa thob pa'i/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i phyir/

/'ching pa nyid kyis thar ba'i lam/ /zhes so/ /sems lnga ni yum dang sbyar ba las/ byang chub kyi sems gnas nas g.yo ba dang*/ gnas su babs pas ldang ba dang*/ rdo rjer bzung bas gnas pa dang*/ gyen du drangs pas 'jug pa dang*/ lus la khrem pas don dam pa byang chub kyi sems dang lnga'o/ /de dag gis ni thabs la brten nas myur du grol ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /gnyis pa lam so so'i rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ bskyed rdzogs cig char du bsgom pa dang*/ rim gyis bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ zhi khro gang rung gi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus ci rigs su bsgom nas grol lam ltar de'i ngang la sems spro bsdu med par 'jog par rang byung gi rdzogs rim/ rim gyis bsdus nas mi dmigs par bsgom pa de kho na nyid kyi rdzogs rim mam/ thabs lam gnyis gang rung bsgom pa snying po'i rdzogs rim bsgom ste/ mthar sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyis bsngo ba byed pa ni gdan thog gcig tu rdzogs par byed pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad cig char nyid du bsgom pa ste/ zhi ba rin po che'i drwa ba dang*/ khro bo dam pa rgyan gyi sgrub thabs ltar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis la gnyis te/ lam gyi go don mdor bstan pa dang*/ de'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang zag rtsol ba dang sbyang pa rab tu gyur pa zhig /bskyed rdzogs tshar gcig gis rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang bgrod pa'i dbang du byas na/ bsgom lam bzhi bar chad med lam dang lngar rig 'dzin gyi sa bgrod de tshe 'dir mchog gi sa thob pa'o/ /bsgom lam bzhi ni/ de bzhin nyid/ kun tu snang*/ rgyu yi ge'i sprin/ ye shes drwa ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni tshogs bsgrub pa'o/ /de dag so so'i dgos pa'ang*/ stong pa chen po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis/

dang po lta bas thag bcad pas bskyed rdzogs rang rgyud du mi zhen pa'i dgos pa yod cing*/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshe chos sku'i ngang las gzugs sku 'char ba'i gzhi gyur pas de'i rten 'brel mngon du byed pa dang*/ lam ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /kun snang snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin sgyu ma dang mig yor lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ stong pa'i mthar zhen pa las grol zhing thabs snying rje chen po'i bsgom pa lam du byed pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshe 'og min gyi zhing khams rgya dang bral ba'i rang bzhin mngon du byed pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin yi ge'i sprin las/ phyag rgya gcig pa'i bar bsgom pas thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel zhing*/ rtag chad zhen pa'i mtha' las 'das pas lam rang gi ngo bo gnyis su med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshe 'og min gyi dkyil 'khor longs sku rang gi ngo bo las mched pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin gtso bo lhun gyis grub pa rten 'brel mngon du byed pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /ye shes drwa ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan dang bkod pa dang*/ 'od zer dang 'phro 'du dang*/ 'khor gyi rol pa dpag tu med pa rdzogs la/ phyag rgya spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'og min gyi longs spyod chen po sprul pa'i sku 'phro gzhi rdzogs pa dang*/ lam ye shes dang stong pa chen po'i tshogs gnyis lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i dgos pa dam pa 'grub bo/ /bar chad med pa'i tshogs bsgrubs pas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nus pa 'byin cing rig 'dzin gyi sa bsgrub pa la dngos su bar chad med par sbyor ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /de dag rim gyis bsgom pa'i tshe lam gyi rdzogs tshul yang*/ de bzhin nyid ni tshogs lam chung ngu*/ kun tu snang tshogs lam 'bring*/ rgyu'i phyag rgya gcig spros tshogs lam chen po/

ye shes drwa ba'i phyag rgya rnam spros sbyor lam drod dang*/ rtse mo/ bar chad med pa bzod pa dang*/ chos mchog chen po mthar thug pa'i ye shes rdzogs so/ /'di dag lam zag pa dang bcas pa ste 'jig rten pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang de dag bsgom pa'i tshe sa de dag gi rtags rdzogs nas lam gong mar 'jug gi

ma rdzogs kyi bar du rang bzhin gyis de la nges par slob pa'o/ /ji ltar zhe na tshogs lam rdzogs pa'i rtags/ sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul sku mthong ba dang*/ gzungs thob pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul cung zad 'grub pa na sbyor lam la 'jug go /de'ang lus shig sro med pa dang*/ srin bu med pa la sogs pa thob nas/ gong ma la gong ma 'jug pa ste/ rgyas par pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de'ang bar chad med pa'i skabs su rnam smin rig 'dzin thob pa'o/ /rten de la tshe dbang ma thob par shi na/ lus rgya dang bral ma thag sems lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin la sbyar nas lhun grub thob ste/ tshe dbang bor nas shi ba'o/ /rgyu mtshan lus dor bas tshe dbang ma thob pa'o/ /ma shi na chos mchog chen po'i ye shes mthar thug las mthong lam dngos su skye bas/ skye shi med pa rdo rje'i skur gyur pa'i phyir tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /de nas mthong zin goms par byed pa'i lam sa bcu ni phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin te/ chos nyid zag pa med pa'i don goms shing*/ sa gong ma'i yon tan rdzogs par gong nas gong du 'gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi sa la sbyor ba yin no/ /'di dag la nya tshal pa la sogs pa kha cig na re/ rnam smin lam gyi rten la tshe dbang mi 'byung*/ phyag rgya chen po sa gnyis pa nas brgyad pa'i bar dang*/ lhun grub dag pa sa gsum tshe dbang sa dang po dang mnyam zhes 'dod pa'ang*/ sgyu 'phrul spyi'i dgongs pa ma lon cing*/ sa lam gyi don rnams legs par khong du ma chud par nges so/ /de'ang rnam smin gyi rten la tshe dbang thob mi thob gnyis yod de/ bar du chad na phyag rgya la sbyor/ ma chad na/ tshe dbang la sbyor te de'ang bzod pa'i skabs yin gyi/ chos mchog gi rten la mthong lam dngos su thob pas tshe dbang la sbyor te/

thun mong gi theg pas kyang*/ de ni chos mchog dang sa gcig /ces pas 'grub bo/ /tshe dbang sa dang po yin pa 'thad kyi/ sa dang po kho nar 'jog na mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas kyi sa de nyid mthar thug gi tshe dbang yin te/ dbang bcu'i don la dbang thob pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag rgya yang 'phags pa'i bden mthong sa dang po'i skad cig nas bcu pa'i bar yin te/ 'phags pa'i ye shes de nyid la mdo rgyud thams cad nas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub tu gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sa gnyis pa nas brgyad pa la thug gi bar 'jog pa de kho nar yang mi 'thad do/ lhun grub ni sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'dod de/ 'di las/ de tshe bcu drug tshun chad kyis/ sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs pa ni/ /zhes pas/ mthar phyin pa'i lam du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dag sa gsum lhun grub mthar thug ma yin te/ gzhan don byed pa la ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsol ba yod pa'i phyir dang*/ rang don du sangs rgyas thob byar yod pas rang don mthar thug lhun gyis ma grub pa'i phyir dang*/ sa de pa'i sems dpa' don mi byaid pas gzhan don mtha' dag lhun gyis ma grub pa'i phyir dang*/ spang rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' dag lhun gyis ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni rig 'dzin gong ma gong ma la 'og ma'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i cha nas der 'jog la/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na mthar thug gi rig 'dzin thams cad rdzogs te/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la mnga' brnyes pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag rgyas par 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa de'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa la lnga ste/ de bzhin nyid/ ye shes sgyu ma/ phyag rgya gcig pa/ phyag rgya spros bcas/ bar chad med pa'o/ / dang po la bzhi las/ lta ba ni/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas dag cing bden pa dbyer med sems nyid kyi don te/ rnam bkod las/ nam mkha'i ngos bzung med pa ltar/ /snang srid thams cad de dang 'dra/ /chos rnams thams cad sems yin te/
