/sems ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes so/ sgom pa ni/ sems bskyed pa'i rjes la chos nyid grub bsal med pa'i ngang la 'jog pa ste/ las rim las/ rtog pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /de nyid rang gsal mi g.yo ba/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel/ /zhes so/ /spyod pa ni/ rang don du mi dmigs pa gsum gyi ngang las sgyu ma'i tshul gyis spyad cing*/ gzhan don du/ las bzhi/ sgrub pa gsum dbang lnga la sogs mos slob kyi spyod pa ste/ rim pa bzhin de nyid las/ spyod dgu dor ba'i gcig cha yang*/ mi dmigs mthun par spyod ces bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ shes 'jug kun dang gzhan don du/ /las bzhi spyod cing bsgrub dbang che/ /spros pa'i 'khor lo mngon bsgom zhing*/ /lam kun skad cig chas bsgoms nas/ /nus pa 'byin ldan rdzogs par byed/ /ces so/ /'bras bu ni/ dngos su don dam rtogs pa dang*/ /brgyud nas chos sku thob pa ste/ /yang de nyid las/ snang stong gnyis med rnal 'byor mtha'// mngon byas lhag pa'i chos skur sbyor/ /ces so/ /lam 'di kun gyi sngon du 'gro zhing zin dgos te 'di med na mi 'grub pa yang*/ gal te bsam gtan 'di med na/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jing gi pha bong bzhin/ /bskal par lam la brtson byas kyang*/ /don gyi snying po skam pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ye shes sgyu ma la'ang bzhi las/ lta ba ni/ chos thams cad bden pa dbyer med sgyu ma'i ngang du gsal ba ste/ 'di nyid las/ skad cig ma skyes ma 'gags pas/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rig pa nyid/ /ye shes sgyu mar mi g.yo gsal/ /chu dang zla ba ji bzhin du/ /mtshungs par gsal ba'i ngo bor brjod/ /ces so/ /sgom pa la/ sngon 'gro tshad med pa bzhi dang snying rje chen pos brlan par bya ste/ sngon du stong goms rnal 'byor pa/ /khams gsum thugs rjes bzung ba'i phyir/ /yan lag brgyad pa sngon bzhin bya/

/ zhes so/ /de'ang stong pa nyid kyi bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ de'i ngang las snying rje chen po'i tshad med bzhi ste yan lag brgyad do/ /dngos gzhi ni de'i rjes la chos thams cad med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad kyi ngang la/ phyam me/ wal le/ rang gsal mi rtog par bzhag pa ni chos thams cad dang de nyid gang du'ang 'dzin pa med pa nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid kyi ngang la lhan ner bzhag ste/ de bas gnyis goms rgyu goms pas/ /dran las spyi blug ye shes gsal/ /mngon du btang bzhag gang yang med/ /nam mkhar nam mkha' ji bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /de ni yul nam mkha' dang blo nam mkha' bzhin du rtog med bsam brjod las 'das par 'jog pa'o/ /spyod pa ni/ chags sdang dug lnga sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med par spyad de/ rnam rtog mtshan ma ci skyes kyang*/ /ye shes sgyu mar rang snang phyir/ /chags sdang re dogs med par spyad/ /ces so/ /'bras bu ni/ dngos su kun rdzob kyi bden pa rtogs pa dang*/ brgyud nas longs sku thob ste/ lam 'dir cha rkyen rdzogs grub pa/ / mtshan dang dpe byad kun dang ldan/ /dbang phyug chen po'i gnas nyid du/ / mngon du 'byung bar the tshom med/ /ces so/ /gsum pa phyag rgya gcig pa la bzhi las/ lta ba ni/ bden pa dbyer med lha yi rang bzhin du ye nas dag pa shes pa ste/ thams cad lhun rdzogs lha yi sku/ /phyag rgya chen por ye nas gnas/ /zhes so/ sgom pa na/ ting nge 'dzin snga ma rnams sngon du song nas/ dbyings kyi rgyu yi ge'i sprin las/ ye shes kyi rgyu dkyil 'khor du lha phra rags gang mos rim gyis sam/ cig char du gsal bar bsgom ste rim pa star/ a/ rab tu brtan gyur a dkar las/ /shin tu phra ba'i a rnams sprau/ /zhes pa dang*/ phyi ma tshangs pa srin po'i tshul/ /rdzogs par bya ba zung du 'gyur/ / zhes so/ /de'ang zhi khro gnyis las/ rim gyis pa dang*/ cig char ba gnyis las/

rim gyis pa la'ang*/ phra ba ni/ rnam snang rtsa ba'i ston pa 'dra ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis par hūm̐ las bsgom pa ste/ de dkyil yi ge hūm̐ gnas pa'i/ /mthing ka 'tsher la rab gsal ba'i/ /'od zer 'phro ba rnam par bsgom/ /zhes so/ /rags pa ni/ zhal gsum phyag drug yan lag gi lha dang bcas pa bsgom ste/ lam rim las/ de bzhin gnyis med gsal gyur nas/ /sku gcig rdo rje dril 'bar bsgom/ /de bzhin nyid du gyur pa dang*/ / dbu gsum phyag drug nyid du bsgom/ /zhes so/ /cig char du bsgom pa ni/ skad cig gis chu las nya ldang gi tshul du bsgoms te/ de las/ yang na phyag rgya chen po ste/ /chu las nya ldang ji bzhin du/ /bdag nyid phyag rgya chen po ste/ / zhal gsum phyag drug rtag tu bsgom/ /zhes pa dang*/ nyi zla gza' skar dus gcig tu/ /chu dkyil dwangs par gsal ba ltar/ /skad cig skur gsal 'od du 'bar/ /snying po brjod pas 'khor lo gsal/ /ces so/ khro bo'i lha bsgom pa la'ang rim dang cig char te/ raksha'i cha lugs 'dzin pa yang*//rim dang cig char sngon bzhin te/ /zhes so/ /rim la'ang phra ba ye shes sems dpa' buddha he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ste/ phra ba'i gzhal yas gdan dang ldan/ /gnas gcig ye shes sems dpa' bsgom/ /zhes so/ /rags pa la'ang sngar bzhin no/ /cig char ba yang 'dra'o/ /spyod pa ni/ dus thams cad du lta ba'i ngang las spyod pa ste/ 'di'i tshe sa gzhi kun ldan mod/ /gsung gi gzhi la lhur bya zhing*/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor du/ /spyod yul thams cad spyad par bya/ /zhes so/ 'bras bu ni/ dngos su bden pa dbyer med rtogs pa dang*/ brgyud nas yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa thob pa ste/ lam rim las/ rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyis/phyag rgya chen po rdzogs 'gyur zhing*/ /gsang ba'i yid gnyis med pa na/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'bar bar gyur/ /ces so/ /bzhi pa phyag rgya spros bcas la bzhi las/

lta ba ni/ thams cad dkyil 'khor du sangs rgyas pa ste/ rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /sgom pa la'ang*/ lam snga ma rnams sngon du song nas/ rim mam cig char gyis phung po la sogs pa lha yi dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa ste/ snga ma las/ phung sogs dkyil 'khor lhar snang ba/ /rgya mtsho'i gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du/ /kun dngos rang rig lhar gsal ba/ /gcig dang du ma yongs kyis med/ /gsal cha yul med mi g.yo ba/ /rnal 'byor ngo bor rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes so/ /de la dbye na zhi khro gnyis las/ re re la'ang*/ dkyil 'khor spros bcas/ tshom bu/ rnam grangs/ zhal phyag ste bzhi bzhi'o/ dang po zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor spros bcas la gsum ste/ bsdus pa/ 'bring*/ rgyas pa'o/ dang po lha grangs bco brgyad de/ gtso bo rigs lnga dang kun tu bzang po gang gis byed so so'i rigs dang mthun pas ma nges te/ yab yum gnyis la rigs chung brgyad kyis bskor bas bcu/ sgo ba yab yum brgyad de bco brgyad do/ /dkyil 'khor 'bring po la/ rdo rje dbyings ky-i lha tshogs bzhi bcu zhe gnyis so/ /rgyas pa la brgyad cu rtsa gnyis te/ dbus na rigs lnga la rang rang gi rigs chung gis bskor bas lnga bcu tham pa/ khro bo dang khro mo nyi shu ste bdun cu/ thub pa drug sgo ma bzhi ste brgyad cu/ kun bzang yab yum gnyis dang rtsa gnyis so/ /lam rim las/ dang po bco brgyad bzhi bcu gnyis/ /rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor rim bzhin slob/ /ces so/ /tshom bu spros pa la'ang gsum las/ dang po tshom bu gcig pa la lha grangs bco brgyad de/ gtso bo rnam snang la/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rin chen rdo rje/ chos rdo rje/ las rdo rje bzhi'i yum/ brtan ma rdo rje/ 'bar ma rdo rje/ sdud ma rdo rje/ bskyod ma rdo rje ste yab yum bcu dang*/ phyogs kyi khro bo yab yum brgyad de/ de las/ gnyis po bdag cag yab yum gnyis/

/gnas su dkyil 'khor bsam bya ste/ /gdan ldan dbus na bdag po gnas/ /de la sems dpa' khro bos bskor/ /zhes so/ /tshom bu 'bring po la lha grangs bzhi bcu rtsa drug ste/ sku'i lha mi bskyod pa yab yum la/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje chags pa/ rdo rje legs pa bzhi'i yum/ rdo rje sgeg mo/ rdo rje bdug pa/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje sgrol ma ste yab yum bcu/ gsung gi lha snang ba mtha' yas la/ rdo rje chos/ rnon po/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje smra ba bzhi'i yum/ glu ma/ mar me/ lcags sgrog /gsal bkra ma ste bcu/ gong gi thugs kyi lha rnam snang yab yum gyi rigs bcu ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha sum cu/ phyogs dang mtshams kyi khro bo yab yum bcu drug bsnan pas bzhi bcu rtsa drug ste/ brtan nas mdun rgyab sku gsung thugs/ /'khor lo rdzogs pas 'bru gsum gdab/ /ces so/ de'ang phyogs bzhi'i sgo ba yum brgyad/ mtshams bzhi'i khro bo yab yum brgyad de bcu drug go /tshom bu rgyas pa la lha grangs bdun cu ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi sum cu/ yon tan gyi lha rin chen 'byung ldan la/ rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje gzi brjid/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje bzhad pa bzhi'i yum/ phreng ma/ me tog ma/ zhags pa ma/ bde ba ma ste bcu/ phrin las kyi lha don grub la/ rdo rje las/ bsrung ba/ gnod sbyin/ rdo rje khu tshur bzhi'i yum/ gar ma/ dri chab/ dril bu/ rdo rje sems ma ste bcu bsdoms pas lnga bcu/ phyogs bcu'i khro bo bcu/ khro mo bcu ste bdun cu ni lam rim las/ brtan nas g.yas dang g.yon nyid du/ /yon tan phrin las dkyil 'khor bzhag / rnal 'byor dbang dang tshom bu lnga/ /shin tu 'dris nas dus tshogs sbyar/ / ces so/ /bsgom tshul ni/ rigs bsdus pa'i tshe rigs dang po'i dkyil 'khor dbus su gsal ba'o/ /de brtan nas 'bring po'i tshe mdun dang rgyab tu sku dang gsung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o/

/de brtan nas rgyas pa la g.yas su yon tan dang*/ g.yon du phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu bsgom pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dang tshom bu'i khyad par ni/ kha cig pho brang gtso bo'i cha nas tshom bu/ rnam grangs byung rdzogs kyi cha nas dkyil 'khor/ yang na mi res lha re bsgom pa tshom bu/ lha du ma mi gcig gis bsgom pa dkyil 'khor zer te ha cang ma 'brel lo/ /'dir bsgom pa'i tshe sgo rta babs la sogs pa gzhal yas khang bsgom pa'i cha nas dkyil 'khor/ de mi bsgom par lha rnams grangs tshang du bsgom pas tshom bu'o/ /rnam grangs spros bcas ni/ dang po rigs gsum la slob/ de goms nas rigs lnga la slob/ de goms nas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la slob/ de la goms nas sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor la bslab ste/ rtsa ba rnam snang yab yum la/ yab la rigs lnga/ sems dpa' brgyad*/ thub pa drug sgo ba bzhi ste nyi shu rtsa gsum/ yum la yum lnga/ sems ma brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi ste bcu bdun bsgom pa ni thabs kyi lha bzhi bcu zhes bya'o/ /de dag gi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba re bsgom pa ni shes rab kyi lha bzhi bcu zhes bya'o/ de yang gtso bo ni yab yum dngos yin pas tha dad du bsgom mi dgos/ gal te bsgom na bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do/ /rags pa dang phra ba'i cha nas thabs dang shes rab tu btags pa ste/ rgyas pa las/ chen po rags pa thabs su rtogs/ /mtshan nyid 'dzin pa shes rab bo/ /zhes so/ /thabs kyi lha re re la sku gsung thugs kyi lha gsum gsum bsgom pas mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i lha brgya nyi shu/ gong gi thabs dang shes rab kyi lha brgyad cu ste nyis brgya la/ rang rang gi rigs kyi gtso byas pa'i dbu rgyan gyi lha lnga re ste/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor stong ngo*/ /de'ang thabs kyi lha la dbu rgyan bgrangs shing shes rab lha la mi bgrangs bas/

thabs kyi lha bzhi bcu/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha gsum gsum/ de re re la dbu rgyan lnga lnga/ de'i steng du shes rab kyi lha bzhi bcu bsnan pas stong du 'gyur te/ 'di nyid las/ yan lag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /de nyid yan lag spros bdag ste/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gsum 'phror 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ snga ma las/ stangs dpyal gnyis kyi phyag rgya dang*/ /sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor yang*/ /ri rab til 'bru'i tshul bzhin tu/ /dpe byad mtshan gyis spras pa 'o/ /zhes so/ /nyi khri chig stong la bslab pa ni/ rigs lnga/ rgyal mchog kun tu bzang po yab yum dang bcas pa la stong phrag drug sems dpa' yab yum cha brgyad dang*/ sgo ba yab yum cha bzhi ste/ cha bcu gnyis la stong phrag bcu gnyis/ thub pa drug la yum med pas stong phrag gsum ste/ de ltar yang nyi khri chig stong ngo*/ /

nyi khri bzhi stong du 'dod pa ni yum yod par rlom pa yin no/ de skad du yang snga ma las/ de ltar ldan pa'i gtso mchog gis/ /rgyal ba rgyal mchog de bzhin te/ /bcu gnyis drug gi 'od 'phro 'bar/ /zhes dang*/ las rim las/ de ltar gtso mchog ldan bya ste/ /bya byed rigs lnga stong bsgom bya//bcu gnyis drug gi 'od 'phro bar/ /nyi khri chig stong dus gcig gsal/ /ces so//de la brtan pa dang bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin la slob ste/ snang srid thams cad lha yi dkyil 'khor du gsal bar bsgom mo/ /zhal phyag spros bcas ni/ dang po zhal gc-ig phyag gnyis pa la bslab bo/ /de nas tshom bu'i lha thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug par slob ste/ de nyid las/ gzhi gcig zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /brtan nas gsum kyang de bzhin te/ /lnga la'ang rjes su mthun bsgom nas/ /spros pa'-i zhal phyag rgyas gsal lo/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa khro bo'i phyag rgya spros pa la'ang bzhi ste/ dkyil 'khor/ tshom bu/ zhal phyag /rnam grangs so/ /dang po la dkyil 'khor bsdus 'bring rgyas gsum las/ bsdus pa la khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad do/ /'bring po la de'i steng du khro bo bcu bsnan pas drug cu rtsa brgyad do/ /rgyas pa la brgya rtsa brgyad de/ dbus su buddha he ru ka yab yum la/ badzra/ ratna/ padma/ karma bzhi'i yum/ badzra/ ratna/ padma/ karma kro dhī shwa rī ma bzhi ste bcu/ shar tu badzra he ru ka yab yum gyi 'khor/ mi tri/ ka ru/ lo ka bing du garba he ru ka bzhi'i yum/ mi tri kro dhī shwa rī ma la sogs pa bzhi ste bcu/ lhor ratna he ru ka yab yum la 'khor/ yaksha/ raksha/ bhi sha sa nu he ru ka bzhi'i yum/ yaksha kro dhī shwa rī ma la sogs bzhi ste bcu/ nub tu padma he ru ka yab yum la 'khor/ te sha ke sha pe sha/ bi sha he ru ka bzhi'i yum/ te sha kro dhī shwa rī ma la sogs pa bzhi ste bcu/ byang du karma he ru ka yab yum la 'khor/

trag sha hri sha ke sha bag sha he ru ka bzhi'i yum trag sha kro ddhī shwa rī ma la sogs pa bzhi ste bcu rnams bsdoms pas lnga bcu/ gnas yul sgo ma nyi shu/ dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ khro bo bcu ste/ de nyid las/ dang po lnga bcu brgyad goms nas/ /drug cu rtsa brgyad de bzhin te/ /yab yum mthar phyin 'khor lo'i chas/ /lnga bcu tshom bu gnas yul dang*/ /sgo slas hūm̐ chen brgyad rtsa brgyad/ /ces so/ /tshom bu la'ang bsdus 'bring rgyas gsum las/ bsdus pa tshom bu gcig pa la lha grangs bdun cu rtsa brgyad de/ buddha he ru ka la rigs bzhi'i he ru ka yab yum gyis bskor bas bcu/ gnas yul sgo ma nyi shu/ dbang mo nyer brgyad/ khro bo yab yum nyi shu'o/ /'bring po la dgu bcu rtsa brgyad de/ sku'i rigs lnga yab yum bcu/ gsung gi padma he ru ka rigs lnga yab yum bcu/ thugs kyi bcu ste sum cu/ gnas yul sgo ma nyi shu/ dbang mo nyer brgyad/ khro bo yab yum nyi shu'o/ /rgyas pa la brgya dang bco brgyad de/ de'i steng du rin po che rigs kyi he ru ka yab yum bcu/ las kyi rigs kyi bcu'o/ /de skad du/ lam rim las/ dbus kyi he ru bzhi po la/ /sku gsung khrag 'thung mdun rgyab gsal/ /de brtan 'khor dang bcas pa bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs la brtan byas nas/ /g.yas g.yon yon tan las khro bo/ /yab yum gsal nas 'khor lo'i lha/ /rdzogs par bsgom pa rim bzhin du/ /gong nas gong du gyen du 'bar/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis snga ma snga ma brtan nas phyi ma phyi ma bsgom pa'o/ /zhal phyag spros bcas ni sngar bzhin no/ /rnam grangs spros bcas ni/ dang po khro bo rigs lnga la bslab/ de nas brgya rtsa brgyad la bslab/ de la brtan nas buddha he ru ka yab yum la/ yan lag gi lha thabs kyi he ru ka lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ de la dbu rgyan lnga lnga byas pas/ yan lag gi lha nyis brgya dang dgu bcu la bslab pa ste/

de nyid las/ yan lag bkod pa lnga bcu brgyad/ /cha lnga'i grangs ni nyis brgya dang*/ /dgu bcu lha rnams yang dag ldan/ /ces so/ /de las kyang spros na/ rtsa ba he ru ka yab yum la/ yan lag gi lha lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bsgom ste/ thabs kyi lha lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ de dag gi snying gar shes rab kyi lha lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ shes rab kyi lha phar bzhag pa'i thabs kyi lha la sku gsung thugs kyi lha gsum gsum bsgoms pas brgya bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ de la dbu rgyan rigs lnga lnga bsgoms pas sku gsung thugs kyi lha'i dbu rgyan brgya bdun cu tshan pa gsum dang*/ thabs kyi lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la nyis brgya dgu bcu ste/ dbu rgyan gyi lha nyis stong dgu bcu'o/ de thams cad bsdoms pas sum stong chig brgya dang dgu bcu yod do/ /spyod pa ni/ spyod lam rnam bzhi nyin mtshan du bskyed rdzogs lha'i ngang las ma nyams par spyad de/ lam rim las/ spyod yul mthong thos thams cad kun/ /'gro dang 'dug dang nyal ba na/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi rnal 'byor las/ /ma nyams de yi dbyings na gnas/ /zhes so/ /'bras bu ni/ dngos su bar chad med pa la sbyor la/ brgyud nas yi ge 'khor lo'i sa thob pa de nyid las/ spros pa'i rnal 'byor rgyun chags pa/ /bsod nams ye shes longs spyod kyis/ /mun snang dug 'gyur tshul bzhin du/ /yi ge 'khor lo'i tshogs mchog brnyes/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa bar chad med pa'i lam tshogs bsgrub pa la'ang bzhi las/ dang po lta ba ni/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas sangs rgyas shing*/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin gnyis su med par rtogs pa ste/ rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul la sogs pa'o/ /sgom pa la/ sngon 'gro thun mong ba sngar dang 'dra la/ khyad par du gnas yid du 'ong zhing gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang*/ sa padma 'dab brgyad/ bar snang 'o ma'i chu ltar dwangs pa la sogs pa ste/ snga ma las/ sde dpung chen pos mi tshugs shing*/

/sa dang bar snang shis pa dang*/ /lo rgyus rnam gnyis ldan pa yi/ / yid 'ong sa btsal rgyas par bya/ /rnyed nas tshom bu'i grangs bzhin du/ /che chung rkyen dang 'tshams par bya/ /'khor khang phyi dang nang ldan pa'i/ /zhes so/ /de yang phyi mar yo byad ci rigs pa 'jog cing skye bor gsang thub pa dang*/ nang mar sgrub pa po yab yum dngos grub brnyes pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /de lta bu'i khang par sgrub pa'i rdzas dang*/ zas dang*/ yo byad dang*/ sman la sogs pa tshogs par bya ste/ de las/ gos rgyan bza' btung bzang ba dang*/ /sgrub pa'i yo byad lnga rnams dang*/ /dkyil 'khor yo byad mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dngos grub rten dang bar chad zlog /yo byad dag pa bsdu bya ste/ /zhes so/ /dus kyang gza' tshes bzang po ste/ rgyas pa las/ tshes grangs yar gyi brgyad la brtsam/ /shin tu skar ma rgyal rnams la/ /byang chub spyod pa cher spyod pa'i/ /gsang mchog dngos grub myur ba yi/ /gza' skar shis pa'ang 'jug par bya/ /zhes so/ /de'ang de lta bu'i lam goms pa'i rnal 'byor zung gcig gam/ gsum mam/ lnga tshogs na bzang ste/ de dag gis bsgrub par ston pa ste/ rdo rje slob dpon ni/ lam rim las/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /man ngag drod tshad brgyad 'chang ba/ /zhes so/ /'khor ni/ de las/ ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /ma nyams shes bzhin yo byad ldan/ /'grub 'gyur mi ldan don med brlag /ces so/ de'ang rnal 'byor ba du ma tshogs na/ ston pa rdo rje slob dpon che shos yin la gzhan rnams 'khor ro/ /zung gcig la yab ston pa/ yum 'khor yin no/ bsgom pa'i thabs ni/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi ste/ lam dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ nye ba'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi'o/ /dang po lam gyi bsnyen sgrub bzhi la/ lta ba stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor dang*/ snying rje chen po bsgom pa ni bsnyen pa'o/

/phyag rgya gc-ig pa dang*/ spros pa bsgom pa nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o/ /bar chad med par tshogs bsgrub pa ni sgrub pa'o/ mthar lam thob tu nye ba ni sgrub pa chen po'o/ /de nyid las/ byang chub sems rtogs 'grub pa ni/ /bsnyen pa'i dam pa yin pa'i phyir/ /sems chos snying rje yan chad do/ /phyag rgya gsal ba nye bsnyen pa/ / de phyir gcig dang spros pa'o/ /bsgrub pa nyid ni bar chad med/ /dus kyi tshogs mthas sgrub chen len/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi ni/ sgrub pa'i shoms 'brel ka dang bcas pa bsnyen pa/ zla ba gcig sgrub pa'i dbang du byas na zla phyed nye ba'i bsnyen pa/ bco lnga man chad kyi zhag bcu bzhi sgrub pa/ nub tha ma dngos grub len kha ma ni sgrub pa chen po'o/ / yang de la zla zhag phyed nyer bsnyen/ /lha gsal 'phro 'du snod du rung*/ /bco lnga mar phyed sgrub pa ste/ /'phro 'du bsnol mas bsgrub par bya/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa sbyor ba'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi ni/ yum mtshan ldan btsal nas chas su zhugs pa bsnyen pa/ 'dod pa'i bde ba rgyas par byed pa nye ba'i bsnyen pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rol pa sgrub pa/ byang chub kyi sems mkhar phab ste sems lnga rim par skye ba sgrub pa chen po'o/ /bzhi pa nye ba'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi ni/ sems nyid rang la yod pas bsnyen pa/ gzhan nas mi tshol bas nye ba'i bsnyen pa/ snying po rnyed pas sgrub pa/ rang gsal goms pas sgrub pa chen po'o/ de dag ni zhi ba dang*/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gang sgrub kyang shes par bya'o/ /spyod pa ni/ sgrub pa'i grogs su gang 'gyur ba spyod cing gtso bor a li ka li'i 'byor pa la spyod pa ste/ de nyid las/ spyod lam yo byad lnga spyod cing*/ /gtso bor dgos pa gang yin pa/ /zhes so/ /'bras bu ni/ dngos su mthong lam la sbyor la/ brgyud nas yi ge 'khor lo'i sa thob pa'o/ /de dag gis lam bsgrub pa rgya cher bshad zin to/

/gsum pa 'bras bu'i rnam par bzhag pa la gnyis te/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rnam smin/ tshe dbang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin no/ /dang po ni/ rnal 'byor pas lam du bskyed rdzogs bsgrub pas lus tha mal du yod la/ sems lha'i skur smin pa ste/ rgyas pa las/ rgya mig rgya sa ji lta bar/ /phyag rgya thob la ma reg pa'i/ gzugs rdzogs stobs chen de kho na/ /zhes so/ /de'ang chos mchog ma thob par shi na bar dor phyag rgya la sbyang nas rim gyis 'tshang rgya ste/ lam rim las/ gcig dang du ma'i rnal 'byor pa/ /brtan bya nyid pa'am de thob nas/ /zla drug bcu drug bsnyen bsgrub tshe/ /rdo rje'i lus su ma gyur par/ /stobs chung rkyen dman zhan pa'i phyir/ /rnam rtog 'byung ba'i lhag lus bzhag /rdo rje 'chang sar rig pas 'gro/ /zhes so/ chos mchog thob nas tshe dbang la dngos su sbyor te/ de las/ rkyen gyis bar ma chad pa na/ /de yang rdo rje'i lus su sbyor/ /zhes so//gnyis pa tshe dbang rig 'dzin ni/ lam snga ma mthar phyin pas lus de nyid rdo rje'i sku grub nas skye 'chi med cing*/ sems 'phags pa'i ye shes dang po thob pa ste/ lam rim las/ don mthong 'jug pa mthar phyin pa'i//tshogs spyod bsgrub pa'i dngos grub kyis/ /lus khams skye gnas zag pa zad/ /rdo rje lus gyur tshe yi rigs/ /mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'das/ /lus ma bor ba rgyal ba'i sa/ /'jigs pa kun bral cho 'phrul rdzogs/ zhes so/ /rnam pa ni sngon lha mi gang yin der snang ste/ mi dang lha dang tshangs pa yi/ skye ba rnam dag 'dzin mod kyang*/ /khyad par sa la gnas gyur yin/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin ni/ sems mtshan ma med par phyag rgya chen po'i rig pa 'dzin pa ste/ sa dang po skad cig gnyis pa nas/ bcu pa'i bar te bsgom lam zag med la gnas shing*/ lus dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo zhi khro longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rigs lnga'i cha lugs su snang byed chu'i zla ba lta bur gnas te rim pa ltar/

mnyam pa nyid las mi g.yo zhing*/ /zag pa med pa bsgom pa'i lam/ /zhes pa dang*/ rang sems phyag rgya chen po ste/ / bsgom pas gang yin mngon gyur sku/ /thun mong mchog gi mtshan dper ldan/ /longs spyod gnyis pa phyag rgya'i rigs/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dang*/ /padma ral gri'i rig 'dzin 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gang bsgom pa'i rigs su snang ba dang*/ thun mong gi mtshan dpe dang*/ mchog gi mtshan dpe 'khor gyi rnam pas bskor bar snang ba dang*/ longs sku la gnyis las lam snang gi longs sku thob pas phyag rgya chen po'i rigs yin no/ gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ slob pa'i lam mthar phyin nas mi slob pa'i lam la gnas pa'i phyir mthar lam mngon du mdzad cing*/ chos sku'i shes rab spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba gnas lugs don gyi ye shes dang*/ longs sku'i shes rab dug lnga ye shes su shar ba rang byung gi ye shes dang*/ sprul sku'i shes rab ji snyed ji lta mkhyen nas phrin las lhun grub kyi ye shes gsum la mnga' brnyes shing*/ chos thams cad la mnga' dbang rdzogs par lhun gyis grub pa ste/ de nyid las/ snga ma'i rigs las mthu rdzogs pas/ /bshad pa bzhin du dri ma sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas sa yi shes rab gsum/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i rigs su 'byung*/ /zhes so/ /'di la ngo bo mdor bstan pa dang*/ rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas pa de'i tshe/ sku lnga/ gsung lnga/ thugs lnga/ yon tan lnga/ phrin las lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lngar gnas pa las/ sku lnga ni/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mthar phyin pa'i cha nas mngon par byang chub kyi sku dang*/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur dang 'jig 'bral med cing rtag pas mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku dang*/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa spros pa mtha' dag zhi bas chos kyi sku dang*/ lhun ltug po bkod par rang snang dkyil 'khor du rdzogs pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/

gdul bya gang 'dul du snang bas sprul pa'i sku ste/ de tshe sku lnga kun kyang rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /gsung lnga ni/ sku de dag gi gsung ste mngon byang gi gsung rang byung gi ye shes ngo bo nyid du gsal ba/ rdo rje'i gsung grags stong dbyer med 'dus ma byas pa/ chos sku'i gsung skye med smra bsam brjod las 'das pa/ longs sku'i gsung dwangs gsal brda tsam tshig las 'das pa/ sprul sku'i gsung 'gro ba so so'i skad du snang ba de'ang tshangs pa'i dbyangs la sogs pa'i yan lag drug cu lta bu ste/ snga ma las/ gsung lnga rang byung ye nas snang*/ /zhes so/ thugs lnga ni/ kun la dbyer med du khyab pa'i ye shes lnga ste/ de las/ thugs ni rang byung ye shes lnga/ /zhes so/ /yon tan lnga ni/ rang snang longs sku'i snang ba chen po ste/ de'ang rang rig pa byang chub kyi sems nyid zhing khams dang*/ gzhal yas khang dang*/ 'od zer dang*/ gdan khri dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan phun sum tshogs par snang ba ste/ de las/ lhun rdzogs rig pa rang snang ba/ /zhing dang gzhal yas gdan khri rgyan/ /'od zer du ma snang ba ste/ / zhes so/ /phrin las lnga ni/ mdzad pa ste/ gdul bya'i nyon mongs pa dang gnod 'tshe la sogs pa sel bas zhi ba dang*/ bsod nams dang tshe la sogs pa 'phel bar mdzad pas rgyas pa dang*/ bsdu ba bzhis 'khor du sdud pas dbang dang*/ bdud dang gshin rje la sogs pa tshar bcad pas rjes su 'dzin pa drag po dang*/ gdul bya dang 'tshams par gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa la rtsol ba med par de dang der 'byung bas lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las te/ de nyid las/ gdul bya'i bya ba tha dad pas/ /zhi dbang drag rgyas lhun gyis grub/ /gang la 'tshams par 'dul mdzad de/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ rten sku/ brten pa ye shes/ mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ chos kyi sku ni dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig tu gyur pa'i gnas skabs na sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du/

sems sems byung gi 'jug pa mtha' dag zhi bas gang du'ang 'dzin pa med pa'i ye shes shin tu phra ba'i rang bzhin/ gnam gang gi zla ba dbyings su nub pa ltar/ yod pa ma yin te/ rags pa'i rnam pa dang 'di'o zhes sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs pa dang*/ med pa ma yin te/ phra ba'i ye shes 'char gzhir gnas pa dang*/ gnyis dang gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mtha' thams cad las 'das pa'i tshul/ 'di nyid las/ gcig dang du ma bral ba yi/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs te/ /rang byung ye shes gnas med snang*/ /zhes so/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ rang snang lhun stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams/ ye shes rin po che'i ngo bo las lhun gyis grub pa/ 'og gzhi zhi ba dang*/ steng gzhi khro bo'i dkyil 'khor mkha' dbyings kyi 'tha' dbus khyab par sku dang ye shes su 'ja' tshon ltar snang ba ste/ 'di nyid las/ zhing khams bsam yas rnam dag dang*/ /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ / 'khor lo rgyan dang rol mo'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsam yas kun/ /mthong nas nye bar mnyes pa dang*/ /rgya chen gsung las don 'byung ba'ang*/ /mthun pa'i ye shes rang snang ba'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgya mtsho las/ rang snang rgyal ba sems sogs dang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas sa rgyal ba/ / sems dpa' che dang 'joms pa che/ /zhes so/

zhing 'dir ston pas gsang bdag la brjod pa med bzhin du rang byung gi dbyings su snang bas sgyu 'phrul gsungs te/ de nyid las/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i steng dbus su/ /bdag po kun bzang 'khor lo bskor/ /skyes bu bka' sdod mdun na gnas/ /brjod pa med par go bar mdzod/ /ces so/ /sprul sku ni/ de nyid kyi snang cha las rang bzhin sprul pa dang*/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sprul pa'i skur rang snang bas don mdzad de/ de'ang sa bcu'i sems dpa' la longs skur snang bas/ me long du bzhin gyi dri ma snang ba ltar longs sku'i ngos la bltas pas sa bcu'i sems dpa' so so'i sgrib pa mthong nas sbyong zhing 'od zer 'gyed pa yin te/ 'di nyid las/ 'og min bla med gnas mchog tu/ /sku ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la/ /de bzhin gsang mchog mi smra ste/ /sku yis chos rnams mjal bar ston/ /me long bltas pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /dngos kyi mdog ngan thams cad sel/ /'khor gyis de bzhin sku bltas na/ /byang chub sgrib pa gting dpag med/ /me long bzhin du sku la snang*/ /de nas sa bcu rim gyis sbyang*/ /bla med byang chub yang dag 'thob/ /ces so/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i sprul pa'i sku ni/ gdul bya so so'i mos pa dang gnas ris dang mthun pa de kho na 'dra ba yang*/ sprul pa bye ba bsam mi khyab/ /ces so/ /bsdu na 'gro ba rigs drug snang bas/ de dag gi 'dul byed thub pa drug snang ba ste/ 'di las thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i skyes bu thub pa drug ces so/ /gnyis pa brten pa ye shes la gsum las/ chos sku'i ye shes zab cing spros pa dang bral ba ste/ rdo rje las/ chos sku'i ye shes bsam 'das brjod med ngang*/ /zhes so/ longs sku'i ye shes la lnga ste/ stong nyid bsam ngo las 'das pa ji lta ba'i gnas lugs kyi ngang la bzhugs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/

rang gsal 'gags pa med pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ chos thams cad lhun mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang las mi g.yo ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ chos can ji snyed pa mngon du gyur pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ gdul bya'i don gnyis 'bad med du rdzogs pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te/ rgyud bla ma las/ ye shes chen po lnga rnams kyang*/ /lhun mnyam ngang las mi g.yo zhing*/ /zhes so/ /sprul sku'i ye shes ni gnyis te/ shes bya'i gnas lugs skye 'gags med par mkhyen pa ji lta ba chos nyid gzigs pa'i ye shes dang*/ chos can ma 'dres par ji ltar yin pa bzhin gzigs pa ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes te/ de nyid las/ sprul sku ji bzhin ji snyed gzigs/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa mdzad pa phrin las ni/ gdul yul sems dpa' dang*/ nyan rang dang*/ so so'i skye bo rnams ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad du/ longs sku'i ngang las sprul skur snang bas 'dul ba bzhi'i tshul gyis don mdzad de/ sku bsod nams chen pos 'dul ba sar gnas la longs sku dang*/ de las gzhan pa rnams la sprul pa'i sku mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i rol pas gdul ba dang*/ thugs mngon par shes pa chen pos 'dul ba don thams cad mngon sum du gyur pas 'dul ba dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'dul ba rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas gdul ba dang*/ gsung rig pas 'dul ba theg pa lnga yi chos kyi rnam grangs stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis gdul bas don mdzad do/ /de'ang dus ji tsam zhig tu mdzad na/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can rnams ma grol gyi bar la mdzad pa ste/ 'di las/ thugs rje chen pos 'brel bas na/ /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus snang*/ /zhes pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las kyang*/ gang gis srid pa ji srid bar/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku 'di ni/
